CVE-2026-110499.description: Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling vulnerability in the HTTP/2 implementation of mtrudel bandit allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to grow per-connection memory and CPU cost without bound via a large SETTINGS_HEADER_TABLE_SIZE. Bandit resizes its HPACK encoder table to whatever size the client advertises, up to 2^32-1 bytes, and indexes response headers into it. Because responses carry distinct values such as date or content-length, nothing is evicted and the table grows with every response for the life of the connection, while each lookup scans it linearly. The SETTINGS handling in Bandit.HTTP2.Connection (lib/bandit/http2/connection.ex) passes remote_settings.header_table_size to HPAX.resize/2 with no server-side cap, and encode_headers encodes every response header as :store. Serving N responses on one connection therefore costs O(N²) CPU in the connection process. This issue affects bandit: from 0.3.6 before 1.14.0.

CVE-2026-111101.description: Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling vulnerability in the HTTP/1.1 chunked body reader of mtrudel bandit allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to exhaust server memory and CPU via a request body made of many 1-byte chunks. The chunked reader in lib/bandit/http1/socket.ex keeps every chunk as its own list cell and binary term until IO.iodata_to_binary/1 joins them, and nothing limits the number of chunks. The :length option of read_body/2 counts only data bytes, so tiny chunks cost far more memory than their payload: 48 MB of 1-byte chunks grew one handler process to about 500 MB and took about 6 s of CPU. The route does not need to read the body, because on keep-alive connections ensure_completed/1 drains unread bodies through the same reader. This issue affects bandit: from 0.1.0 before 1.14.0.

CVE-2026-111103.description: Improper Cleanup on Thrown Exception vulnerability in the HTTP/2 handler of mtrudel bandit allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to bypass per-connection resource limits via a single TCP write that carries several frames, one of which raises a stream error. When a frame raises StreamError partway through a chunk, Bandit.HTTP2.Handler.handle_data/3 sends RST_STREAM and continues with the connection state from before the chunk, dropping the rest of it. Streams opened by earlier frames in the chunk keep running their Plug calls, but the stream counts, last_stream_id, the rapid-reset timestamps, the HPACK decoder state and the buffer roll back, so max_concurrent_streams, max_requests and the rapid-reset limiter never see those streams. A client that sends one HEADERS frame more than max_concurrent_streams in each write has the extra refused and the others forgotten: with a limit of 10, five such writes run 50 Plug calls at once. This issue affects bandit: from 1.9.0 before 1.14.0.

CVE-2026-111590.description: A wide range of Harbor versions allow SSRF via its webhook delivery component which does not properly validate web hook target addresses, allowing usage of private and link-local IP ranges. An authenticated attacker with ProjectAdmin permissions can configure a webhook policy pointing to a private internal address. When a project event fires, Harbor jobservice makes unauthenticated outbound HTTP POST requests to the target. If the target answers with an error status, the response body is written to the webhook execution log, which project members can read, potentially exposing cloud metadata or other network-restricted resources.

CVE-2026-112880.description: Improper Neutralization of CRLF Sequences in HTTP Headers ('HTTP Request/Response Splitting') vulnerability in hackney_http_connect in benoitc hackney allows HTTP Request Splitting via the value a proxy_auth_fun callback returns. After a 407 response from an HTTP CONNECT proxy, hackney_http_connect:handle_proxy_auth/11 calls the caller's proxy_auth_fun with the status code and the response headers and writes the returned binary into the Proxy-Authorization line of the CONNECT retry without checking it. A CR, LF or NUL byte in that value adds header lines to the request sent to the proxy. The value is attacker-influenced when the callback derives it from untrusted data, for example from the proxy's challenge headers. Other caller-supplied values on the CONNECT path, such as the target host and the request headers, were already checked for control bytes. This issue affects hackney: from 2.0.0 before 4.9.0.

CVE-2026-113436.description: Inefficient Algorithmic Complexity vulnerability in the header integer parser of mtrudel bandit allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to consume server CPU via a content-length value or a Host or :authority port made of thousands of digits. Bandit.Headers.parse_integer/2 in lib/bandit/headers.ex builds the number one digit at a time with no limit on the digit count, allocating a new bignum at each step, so one value costs time quadratic in its length. It runs on raw request input over HTTP/1 and HTTP/2, before any range check. Over HTTP/2, a 4,000-digit value can be stored once in the HPACK dynamic table and re-sent on each new stream for about one byte: 124 KB of traffic kept the server busy for 27.9 s. This issue affects bandit: from 1.0.0-pre.7 before 1.14.0.

CVE-2026-113440.description: Insufficiently Protected Credentials vulnerability in hackney in benoitc hackney allows a redirecting server to obtain the basic_auth and cookie credentials of a request via a same-host redirect to another scheme or port. With follow_redirect enabled, hackney:follow_redirect/10 in src/hackney.erl reissues the request to the Location target after hackney:maybe_strip_auth_on_redirect/3, which compared only the hostname of the current and the redirect URL. A redirect from https to http on the same host resent the Authorization and Cookie headers in cleartext, where an on-path attacker can read them, and a redirect to another port on the same host handed them to a different service. location_trusted forwards credentials to any target by design and is unchanged. This issue affects hackney: from 2.0.0 before 4.9.0.

CVE-2026-114213.description: Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling vulnerability in the WebSocket fragment reassembly of mtrudel bandit allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to exhaust server memory via a fragmented message made of many 1-byte continuation frames. Bandit.WebSocket.Connection checks max_fragmented_message_size against the payload bytes received, but keeps every non-final continuation frame as a new list cell around its own binary, and nothing limits the number of fragments. A 1-byte fragment costs 7 bytes on the wire but about 150 to 170 bytes of server memory, so one connection can hold about 150 times the configured limit, roughly 1.2 to 1.4 GB at the default 8 MB. Ping frames between fragments keep the connection alive past the idle timeout. This issue affects bandit: from 1.11.0 before 1.14.0.

CVE-2026-114216.description:
Inconsistent Interpretation of HTTP Requests ('HTTP Request/Response Smuggling') vulnerability in the HTTP/1.1 chunked body reader of mtrudel bandit allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to smuggle a second request past a front-end proxy via a chunk extension that contains a bare LF. The chunked reader in lib/bandit/http1/socket.ex takes the chunk-size line to be everything up to the first CRLF and discards everything after ; without checking it against the RFC 9112 chunk-ext grammar, so bare LF, bare CR and other control bytes pass. A proxy that ends the size line at a bare LF reads 2;
xx
40
... as one request whose second chunk holds a GET /admin, while Bandit ends the body early and dispatches GET /admin as a separate pipelined request. Deployments without such a proxy in front of Bandit are not affected. This issue affects bandit: from 1.12.4 before 1.14.0.

CVE-2026-115188.description: An unrestricted file upload vulnerability exists in the campaign import feature of Mautic 7. When processing an uploaded campaign archive, the application copies the bundled asset files into a publicly accessible media directory without restricting their file names or types. An authenticated user with permission to create campaign imports can exploit this through the user interface or the API (/api/campaigns/import) to place arbitrary files, including server-side scripts, in the web root. Administrator privileges are not required. On web servers that honor per-directory configuration, such as the default Apache setup of the official Mautic Docker image, this leads to remote code execution with the privileges of the web server user, including access to the Mautic configuration, application secrets, and contact data.

CVE-2026-115189.description: A server-side template injection vulnerability exists in the Twig theme rendering sandbox of Mautic. The sandbox introduced to restrict user-uploaded theme templates (the fix for GHSA-9fx4-7cmj-47vg) does not fully enforce its restrictions, allowing a crafted theme template to escape the sandbox. An authenticated user with the core:themes:create permission can upload a malicious theme whose template is later rendered, resulting in execution of arbitrary code on the server with the privileges of the web server process. This allows the attacker to execute operating system commands, read server-side files including configuration files and database credentials, write files, and reach internal services. In default installations the core:themes:create permission is granted to the Administrator role, and in multi-operator setups it may be delegated to other roles. This is an incomplete fix for GHSA-9fx4-7cmj-47vg.

CVE-2026-115190.description: An insecure deserialization (PHP object injection) vulnerability exists in Mautic's handling of segment filters and custom field properties. Several code paths that read these stored values from the database deserialize them without restricting which PHP classes may be instantiated, instead of using Mautic's safe deserialization helper. An attacker who is able to store a crafted serialized value in these segment filter or custom field properties can cause arbitrary PHP objects to be instantiated when Mautic later processes the data, for example during segment evaluation, contact export, or custom field API requests. Combined with gadget chains available in Mautic's dependencies, this could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the server, read, modify, or delete data stored in the Mautic instance, including contact data, and affect its availability. Exploitation requires high privileges or an existing ability to write to the affected stored data.

CVE-2026-115191.description: A SQL injection vulnerability exists in a contact lookup AJAX endpoint of the Mautic administration interface (/s/ajax). A request parameter that selects the contact field to search by is not properly validated before it is used in a database query. Any authenticated Mautic user can exploit this, regardless of the role or permissions assigned to the account. Using blind (boolean-based or time-based) techniques, the attacker can run arbitrary SQL queries against the Mautic database and read any data the Mautic database user can access, including Mautic user accounts with email addresses and password hashes, contact data, and campaign and email content.

CVE-2026-115192.description: An SQL Injection vulnerability exists in the dashboard widget data API endpoint (/api/data/{type}). Chart filter parameters supplied by the client are not properly validated before they are used in the database queries that build dashboard chart data. An authenticated user with API access can exploit this to inject SQL into these reporting queries. Using blind SQL injection techniques, the attacker can read arbitrary data from the Mautic database, including contact and other marketing data and user account data with password hashes. The injected SQL can also be used to slow down database queries, which can have a limited impact on availability. Data modification is not possible through this vulnerability. Exploitation requires the Mautic API to be enabled.

CVE-2026-115193.description: A stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the contact detail view of Mautic 7. Values of HTML-type custom contact fields are rendered without output sanitization. A user or integration able to write a value to such a field (for example, through contact editing, the contact API, or a form submission mapped to the field) can store a script payload in it. When another user, including an administrator, opens the affected contact's detail page, the injected script executes within the context of their active browser session. This could allow an attacker to perform administrative actions on behalf of the victim, such as creating new administrator accounts, altering system configuration, or accessing contact and campaign data.

CVE-2026-115194.description: A path traversal vulnerability exists in the Mautic Asset API. When creating a local asset through the API, the supplied file path is not restricted to the asset upload directory. An authenticated API user with permission to create assets can register any file that is readable by the web server process as a Mautic asset. When the asset is published, its public download URL serves the contents of that file without authentication. This allows the attacker to read arbitrary files from the server, including Mautic configuration files containing the database password, secret key, and mail (SMTP) credentials, as well as system files and any other file readable by the web server user. Exposed credentials can be used to access the database or other connected services, and anyone with the public asset URL can retrieve the file contents.

CVE-2026-115195.description: A broken access control vulnerability exists in the Mautic Stats API (/api/stats/{table}). The endpoint did not enforce permissions for several internal tables: an intended administrator-only restriction was never applied, and tables without an explicit permission mapping were readable by default. As a result, any authenticated API user, including one whose role grants no permissions, could read data from these tables, including the application audit log with actions performed by all users and change details that may contain contact personal data, stored visitor IP addresses and their geolocation details, and tracked redirect URLs and their channel mappings.

CVE-2026-115196.description: An Open Redirect vulnerability exists in the public form submission endpoint (/form/submit) of Mautic. After a form is submitted, the application redirects the visitor to a return address supplied with the submission without verifying that it points to the Mautic instance or another trusted host. An unauthenticated attacker can exploit this to send visitors from a legitimate Mautic domain to an arbitrary external website, for example to phishing pages that imitate the original landing page or to sites that deliver malware. Any Mautic instance with a published form is affected. Exploitation requires the victim to submit a form prepared by the attacker.

CVE-2026-115269.description: Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling vulnerability in the HTTP/2 request body reader of mtrudel bandit allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to hold stream processes open indefinitely via WINDOW_UPDATE or empty SETTINGS frames sent while a Plug reads the request body. Bandit.HTTP2.Stream.do_read_data/4 in lib/bandit/http2/stream.ex waits for each frame with a fresh read_timeout. A stream WINDOW_UPDATE, or the zero-delta window update that every empty SETTINGS frame delivers to all streams, ends the wait without delivering any body data, and the loop starts a new full countdown. A client that sends one of these 9-byte frames before each countdown expires keeps read_body blocked, together with the stream process and whatever the application holds while reading, for as long as it likes. This issue affects bandit: from 1.4.0 before 1.14.0.

CVE-2026-115693.description: Improper Certificate Validation vulnerability in hackney_ssl in benoitc hackney allows an on-path attacker to impersonate a server pinned to a private certificate authority via a certificate chain that ends in a publicly trusted root. hackney adds {partial_chain, fun hackney_ssl:partial_chain/1} to every verify_peer configuration. The callback returns any certificate in the peer chain whose public key matches a root in the bundled certifi store as the trust anchor, and OTP honours that callback over the configured cacerts. hackney_ssl:merge_ssl_opts/3 kept the callback when the caller replaced the trust store with cacerts or cacertfile in ssl_options, so a connection pinned to a private CA still accepted any chain that carried a publicly trusted root. The hostname check still applies, so the attacker needs a publicly trusted certificate for the pinned hostname. This issue affects hackney: from 1.24.0 before 4.9.0.

CVE-2026-115700.description: Interpretation Conflict vulnerability in hackney_url in benoitc hackney allows Server Side Request Forgery via a percent-encoded bracketed IPv6 literal or an IP literal with a trailing dot. A host such as %5B%3A%3Affff%3A127%2E0%2E0%2E1%5D (decoding to [::ffff:127.0.0.1]) or 127.0.0.1. is not an IP address to a caller's allowlist built on uri_string:parse/1 and inet:parse_address/1, while hackney connects to the address it denotes. The same applies to a Location target when redirects are followed. The IP-literal gate that hackney_url:normalize/2 applies to a percent-decoded host, added to close the percent-encoded IP bypass of CVE-2026-47076, passes the decoded value to inet_parse:address/1 as is. The connect path in hackney_happy:parse_address/1 drops a surrounding bracket pair, and the resolver ignores a trailing dot, so both forms pass the gate and still reach the literal address. Domain names with a trailing dot and unencoded IPv6 literals are not affected. This issue affects hackney: from 4.0.1 before 4.9.0.

CVE-2026-116210.description: Webasyst Framework through 4.4.0 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability in the Photos app that allows remote attackers to perform backend actions because the app does not enable the framework's opt-in CSRF check. Attackers can lure logged-in Photos users to a malicious page that submits forged POST requests to photo/delete, album/save, photo/manageAccessSave or photo/saveField, deleting photos and changing access rights.

CVE-2026-116212.description: Webasyst Framework through 4.4.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the Photos app that allows authenticated backend users to inject JavaScript via the album url parameter. Attackers with album edit rights can save a url value that breaks out of the unescaped attribute in DialogAlbumSettings.html, executing JavaScript in administrators' backend sessions.

CVE-2026-116213.description: Webasyst Framework through 4.4.0 contains an arbitrary file read vulnerability in waArchiveTar::writeItem() that creates symlinks from theme archives without validating link targets. Authenticated users with theme management rights can upload themes containing symlinks to wa-config/db.php or /etc/passwd and read them through the public theme path.

CVE-2026-116214.description: MacCMS v10 before 2026.1000.4054 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to reset any member's password because check_msg() never compares msg_to. Attackers can request a recovery code to their own mailbox via user/findpass_msg, then submit it to user/findpass_reset with the victim's email or phone to take over the account.

CVE-2026-116215.description: MacCMS v10 through 2026.1000.4056 contains a race condition vulnerability in Card::useData() that allows authenticated members to redeem one recharge card multiple times via the user/buy endpoint. Attackers can send many concurrent flag=card requests that pass the non-locking card read before it is marked used, inflating user_points to buy VIP upgrades and paid content.

CVE-2026-116216.description: MacCMS v10 through 2026.1000.4056 contains a mass assignment vulnerability in index/Comment::saveData() that allows unauthenticated attackers to set arbitrary mac_comment columns including user_id. Attackers can submit anonymous comments with a crafted user_id parameter to attribute them to any registered member, displaying that member's avatar and impersonating them.

CVE-2026-116217.description: RosarioSIS before 12.9.2 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in modules/Food_Service/MenuReports.php that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject attributes via unescaped menu_id and modname parameters. Attackers can lure a logged-in administrator to a crafted Modules.php link whose double-quoted menu_id injects an onmouseover handler, stealing session and CSRF tokens to act as the administrator.

CVE-2026-116218.description: Dolibarr ERP CRM 19.0.0 before 23.0.4 contains an SQL injection vulnerability that allows authenticated API users to inject SQL via the type field of the third-party bankaccounts REST endpoint. Attackers with only societe/creer permission can break out of the unescaped type value in CompanyBankAccount::create() to read password hashes and API keys via time-based blind subqueries.

CVE-2026-116219.description: Dolibarr ERP CRM before 24.0.0 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in htdocs/admin/tools/export.php that lets authenticated administrators bypass the restrict_os_commands allowlist. Attackers can submit a mysqldump value chaining commands with & characters around an allowlisted basename to execute operating system commands as the web server user.

CVE-2026-116274.description: A vulnerability has been found in JIZHICMS up to 2.5.6. This affects the function Pay of the file app/home/c/OrderController.php of the component Front-end Order Handler. Such manipulation of the argument orderno leads to improper authorization. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

CVE-2026-116275.description: A vulnerability was found in AllenAI AllenNLP up to 2.10.1. This impacts the function Registrable.resolve_class_name of the file allennlp/common/registrable.py of the component Registrable Configuration Machinery. Performing a manipulation of the argument Type results in code injection. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way. This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer.

CVE-2026-116280.description: A vulnerability was determined in Kameleo up to 5.0.1.26. Affected is the function InternalController.TestProxy of the file client-engine-application/f.cs of the component Proxy Validation. Executing a manipulation of the argument host/port can lead to server-side request forgery. The attack may be launched remotely. Upgrading to version 5.2.0 is able to address this issue. It is suggested to upgrade the affected component. The route has been removed and replaced with /general/test-proxy in 5.2.0.

CVE-2026-116281.description: A vulnerability was identified in Kameleo up to 5.0.1.26. Affected by this vulnerability is the function ListProfiles of the file client-engine-application/t.cs of the component Profile Controller. The manipulation leads to information disclosure. The attack can only be performed from a local environment. Upgrading to version 5.2.0 addresses this issue. Upgrading the affected component is recommended.

CVE-2026-116282.description: A security flaw has been discovered in Kameleo up to 5.3.1. Affected by this issue is the function CookieController.ListCookies of the file client-engine-application/w.cs of the component Cookie Controller. The manipulation of the argument guid results in information disclosure. The attack can be executed remotely. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

CVE-2026-116283.description: A weakness has been identified in Kameleo up to 5.0.1.26. This affects an unknown part of the file /profiles of the component Local API. This manipulation causes information disclosure. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. Upgrading to version 5.2.0 is able to mitigate this issue. Upgrading the affected component is advised.

CVE-2026-116485.description: danmu_api before 1.21.7 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to modify server environment configuration when the default TOKEN is used and ADMIN_TOKEN is unset. Attackers can send POST requests to /api/env/set, /api/env/add, or /api/env/del to set ADMIN_TOKEN, lock out operators, redirect OTHER_SERVER or PROXY_URL for SSRF, and trigger redeployment.

CVE-2026-116486.description: Objenesis before 3.6 contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows code in one class loader to substitute objects into another by exploiting instantiator caching keyed on class name. When a shared ObjenesisStd instance caches instantiators by clazz.getName() in ObjenesisBase.getInstantiatorOf(), same-named classes collide, causing newInstance() to return wrong-class objects and ClassCastException failures.

CVE-2026-116487.description: NXP MCUXpresso SDK USB middleware (mcuxsdk-middleware-usb) before 2.13.0 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in USB_DeviceCdcRndisSetCommand() that trusts a host-supplied informationBufferOffset. A malicious USB host can send RNDIS SET messages for OID_GEN_CURRENT_PACKET_FILTER or OID_802_3_MULTICAST_LIST with an out-of-range offset to read and disclose device memory.

CVE-2026-116488.description: NXP MCUXpresso SDK USB middleware (mcuxsdk-middleware-usb) before 2.13.0 contains a heap buffer overflow in host audio, video and CDC class drivers that trust device-supplied bNumEndpoints and bLength values. A malicious USB device can supply crafted descriptors that write endpoint entries past the fixed-size epList array, corrupting heap memory for code execution or denial of service.

CVE-2026-116492.description: Frappe CRM app before 1.89.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated low-privileged users to read CRM Lead records they are not permitted to access by querying the get_contact_by_phone_number API, which performs raw database queries without invoking the permission system. Attackers can supply a known phone number to the crm.integrations.api.get_contact_by_phone_number endpoint to retrieve full lead details otherwise blocked by standard API and UI access controls, resulting in unauthorized disclosure of sensitive CRM data.

CVE-2026-116516.description: Mattermost versions <=11.9 11.1.9 11.5.8 11.10.7.0 fail to validate Zoom chat line length before slicing which allows an authenticated attacker to crash the Agents plugin via summarizing a Zoom chat transcription containing short continuation lines. Mattermost Advisory ID: MMSA-2026-00723

CVE-2026-59106.description: A security vulnerability has been identified in the WolfProt interface implementation. Insufficient neutralization of user-controlled input could allow an unauthenticated attacker with network access to a vulnerable service to execute operating-system commands with the privileges of the affected application service.

CVE-2026-59107.description: A security vulnerability has been identified in the vSolution Matrix file sharing feature. A shared cryptographic trust configuration could allow an attacker who obtains the matching private key to authenticate to an affected device via SSH as root. This vulnerability affects only devices configured as a vSolution Matrix main/master station with the file sharing feature enabled.

CVE-2026-97200.description: Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling vulnerability in hackney_conn in benoitc hackney allows a malicious HTTP server to exhaust client memory via an oversized or highly compressed response body. hackney:request/5 and hackney:body/1 return the whole response body, and nothing bounds how much the connection process buffers. Any server the client requests can trigger it. hackney_conn:read_full_body/2 and the HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 accumulators append every chunk until the body ends. With {auto_decompress, true} the buffered body is then inflated in one step with zlib:gunzip/1 or zlib:inflate/2, which return the whole output at once. This issue affects hackney: from 2.0.0-beta.1 before 4.9.0.

34c9221fc463201c3edadcf3.title_ko: SAMI Suite, 설치 없이 웹에서 바로 편집하는 무료 오피스 서비스 소개
34c9221fc463201c3edadcf3.summary_ko: 사미텍이 출시한 SAMI Suite는 별도의 소프트웨어 설치 없이 웹 브라우저에서 HWP, 워드, 엑셀, 파워포인트, PDF 문서를 열고 편집할 수 있는 무료 웹 오피스 도구입니다. 기존 로컬 문서 검색 도구인 Findex에 이어 사용자의 편의성을 높이기 위해 공개되었습니다.

e78fdcef4310cb89acb5fff3.title_ko: 메타, 개인용 AI 에이전트 '뮤즈'에 실시간 음성 대화 및 아바타 공유 기능 확대
e78fdcef4310cb89acb5fff3.summary_ko: 메타가 AI 에이전트 뮤즈(Muse)에 실시간 음성 대화 기능과 애니메이션 아바타 공유 기능을 추가하며 서비스 고도화에 나서고 있습니다. 또한 업무용 커넥터 확대와 더불어 데이터 보안을 강화하는 컨피덴셜 VM 및 고도화된 모델 '뮤즈 원더' 도입 등을 통해 일상과 업무 영역으로 영향력을 넓히고 있습니다.

a032fb4aadf215a29eaa8ccf.title_ko: Microsoft 365 겨냥한 AitM 기반 토큰 탈취 공격으로 79개 조직 피해
a032fb4aadf215a29eaa8ccf.summary_ko: 사이버 공격자들이 중간자(AitM) 공격을 통해 마이크로소프트 365 세션 토큰을 탈취하고 이를 재사용하여 79개 조직의 계정을 침해하는 사례가 보고되었습니다. 공격자는 다중 인증(MFA)을 우회하고 지속적인 접근을 위해 악성 기기를 등록하거나 이메일 규칙을 변조하여 정보를 탈취하고 있습니다.

1831334bfa97010609eccc67.title_ko: 오픈AI, 국내 스타트업 AI 서비스 개발 지원 프로그램 '모델 마스터즈' 개최
1831334bfa97010609eccc67.summary_ko: 오픈AI가 국내 스타트업의 AI 서비스 개발과 사업 현장의 문제 해결을 지원하기 위해 '오픈AI 모델 마스터즈'를 개최했습니다. 이번 행사에서는 11개 참여 기업이 오픈AI 모델을 활용한 업무 자동화, 영상 편집 솔루션 등 다양한 AI 활용 사례를 선보였으며, 컷백이 1위를 차지했습니다.

43bc421ee81ebd4e4048cd35.title_ko: 오픈AI와 앤트로픽, 가격 할인과 신모델 출시로 AI API 시장 경쟁 격화
43bc421ee81ebd4e4048cd35.summary_ko: 오픈AI가 적극적인 가격 할인과 무료 크레딧을 앞세워 기업 고객 확보에 나선 가운데, 앤트로픽은 고성능 신모델 출시를 통해 점유율을 방어하며 치열한 경쟁을 벌이고 있습니다. 고객사들은 가격 경쟁력과 모델 성능을 바탕으로 서비스 제공업체를 유연하게 변경하고 있어 향후 경쟁 구도는 더욱 복잡해질 전망입니다.

4fc5f21d9f4e28c9530e8630.title_ko: 솔트웨어, 생성형 AI 보안 솔루션 '사피가디언' 민감정보 탐지 특허 획득
4fc5f21d9f4e28c9530e8630.summary_ko: 솔트웨어가 생성형 AI 이용 시 정보 유출을 방지하는 '사피가디언'의 민감정보 탐지 및 제어 기술로 특허를 획득했습니다. 이 솔루션은 규칙 기반 탐지와 AI 문맥 분석을 결합해 기업의 보안 정책에 따라 민감 정보를 차단하거나 마스킹 처리하여 업무 효율성과 보안성을 동시에 지원합니다.

1b748d85801878668a0cc2e4.title_ko: 경찰청-씽크포비엘, AI 영향 평가 및 위험 관리 체계 구축
1b748d85801878668a0cc2e4.summary_ko: 경찰청이 씽크포비엘과 협력해 AI 기획부터 운영까지 전 과정을 관리할 수 있는 글로벌 수준의 위험 관리 체계를 마련했습니다. EU AI 법 및 국제 표준을 반영한 이 체계는 도입 적합성 판별, 신뢰성 검증, 운영 중단 조치 권한 등을 포함하며, 내년 법령 시행에 따른 공공기관의 AI 관리 의무에 대응할 계획입니다.

curation.reason_ko: 경찰청이 AI 도입 및 운영 전 과정의 위험을 관리하기 위해 씽크포비엘과 협력하여 체계를 마련했습니다.

187d364cfee09ef8348cb63d.title_ko: 아우토크립트, ITS 세계총회서 차량 보안 기술 발표
187d364cfee09ef8348cb63d.summary_ko: 아우토크립트가 ITS 세계총회 2026에서 C-ITS 보안 구축 사례와 전기차 충전 보안 기술을 공개했습니다. 또한, 2026년 11월 3일 한국과학기술회관에서 열리는 ‘인공지능 보안 컨퍼런스(AIS 2026)’가 개최될 예정이며, 관련 정보보호 실무자들은 사전 등록을 통해 참석할 수 있습니다.

7b2b6a1017ee4e610c3d8f4f.title_ko: 이디오그램, 편집 가능한 벡터 이미지 생성 AI 모델 공개

659a5a8584d66906bc37a48a.title_original: Interpretable sparse fine-tuning with TopKLoRA enables faithful circuit discovery
659a5a8584d66906bc37a48a.excerpt: arXiv:2610.32866v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Fine-tuning on datasets of unknown origin can create a backdoor in the trained model when the data includes poisoned examples. Difficult to localise and remove, backdoors can persist through safety training. While parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods capture the full parameter changes introduced during training, they are not easily interpretable. We present the full method of TopKLoRA, extending the preliminary proposal of Masiak et al. (2025), an interpretable-by-design LoRA variant in which only the $k$ largest adapter latents are active at each token. Unlike SAEs, TopKLoRA is trained purely on downstream loss, where optimisation pressure incentivises learning functionally causal latents. We demonstrate this sparse LoRA adapter in a sleeper-agent backdoor case study where we create model organisms by fine-tuning gemma-2-2b, Qwen2.5-1.5B, and Qwen2.5-7B on a poisoned instruction-following dataset. For each organism, we identify and ablate a circuit that is both necessary and sufficient to implement the backdoor. Furthermore, our new fine-tuning method produces sparse circuits that are up to an order of magnitude smaller than a dense LoRA baseline, allowing surgical ablation of the malicious capability without sacrificing instruction-following performance. Finally, we propose a technique to construct model organisms with localised circuits using TopKLoRA latents and gradient-routing, which we use to validate the findings of
659a5a8584d66906bc37a48a.title_ko: AI 모델 백도어 탐지 및 제거를 위한 TopKLoRA 연구

1c141ca40a1b594e029298eb.title_original: Ulysses: A Security Harness For Synthesizing Verifiable Web Exploits
1c141ca40a1b594e029298eb.excerpt: arXiv:2610.31831v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: How can an AI agent automatically discover security vulnerabilities in any software repository? Existing approaches use LLMs to generate software vulnerability exploits. However, it is challenging for an LLM to reliably verify its own generated exploits. In this paper, we propose Ulysses, a multi-agent security harness to synthesize verifiable vulnerability exploits for web applications. Ulysses converts candidate vulnerability findings into verified Proofs of Exploitability by iteratively exploring exploit hypotheses and establishing success in independently observed execution effects. We evaluated Ulysses on WebExploitGym, a curated benchmark of exploitable instances from 25 real-world web applications that span 5 languages and 7 frameworks. Ulysses produces verified proofs for 10 of 25 real-world advisories. It also discovered 4 new proofs of exploitability that have never been previously reported.

CVE-2026-112345.description: TTLock Android application before v9.8.260718 and associated smart-lock firmware contain a hardcoded static AES key vulnerability that allows an attacker within Bluetooth range to decrypt the per-pairing session key transmitted during BLE pairing. Attackers can observe the pairing exchange, recover the persistent session key using the embedded defaultKey, and forge authenticated BLE requests to unlock the device, add fingerprints or access codes, and perform administrative actions without authentication or user interaction.
CVE-2026-112345.summary_ko: TTLock 안드로이드 앱과 스마트락 펌웨어에 하드코딩된 정적 AES 키가 존재합니다. 공격자는 블루투스 범위 내에서 세션 키를 복호화해 인증 없이 기기 잠금을 해제하거나 관리자 권한을 수행할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: TTLock 안드로이드 앱과 펌웨어의 고정 AES 키 사용으로 블루투스 범위 내에서 무단 잠금 해제 등 공격 가능

CVE-2026-112346.description: OpenHands Software Agent SDK before 1.52.0 contains an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability where the DockerWorkspace and Apptainer workspace launchers bind the sandbox agent server to all network interfaces (0.0.0.0) with an empty session_api_keys list, disabling authentication by default. Attackers who can reach the published container port can send unauthenticated HTTP and WebSocket requests to execute arbitrary shell commands as root in the sandbox, access the mounted workspace, and read plaintext secrets from the secrets store.
CVE-2026-112346.summary_ko: OpenHands 소프트웨어 에이전트 SDK의 워크스페이스 런처가 인증 없이 네트워크 인터페이스에 바인딩됩니다. 공격자는 이를 통해 샌드박스 환경에서 임의의 셸 명령을 실행하거나 기밀 데이터에 접근할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: OpenHands 에이전트 SDK의 샌드박스 에이전트 서버 설정 미흡으로 인증 없이 루트 권한 코드 실행 가능

CVE-2026-93328.description: Path Traversal and Missing Authorization in cloud-storage source in Google Cloud MCP Toolbox for Databases (googleapis/mcp-toolbox) versions 1.2.0 through 1.4.0 allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to exfiltrate host files to external Google Cloud Storage buckets and overwrite arbitrary local files via crafted tool invocation parameters.
CVE-2026-93328.summary_ko: Google Cloud MCP Toolbox의 클라우드 스토리지 소스에서 경로 탐색 및 권한 부여 누락 취약점이 발견되었습니다. 인증되지 않은 원격 공격자가 호스트 파일을 외부 버킷으로 유출하거나 로컬 파일을 덮어쓸 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Google Cloud MCP Toolbox의 경로 탐색 취약점으로 인증 없이 호스트 파일 탈취 및 조작 가능

CVE-2026-10757.description: There is a SQL injection vulnerability in Esri ArcGIS Server versions 12.1 and earlier on Windows and Linux that may allow a remote attacker with privileges to access the service (which could, depending on the service being configured in a non-default access configuration “public”, include an anonymous attacker) to issue database specific functions that should not be allowed. A patch is provided for ArcGIS Server software in General Availability and Extended support status, which includes versions 12.1, 12.0, 11.5, 11.3, and 11.1. Other versions are in mature or retired status, which are not patch eligible. Users working with unlisted versions are advised to upgrade and apply the patch.
CVE-2026-10757.summary_ko: Esri ArcGIS Server에 원격 공격자가 허용되지 않은 데이터베이스 함수를 실행할 수 있는 SQL 삽입 취약점이 존재합니다. 서비스 접근 권한이 있는 사용자는 공격 대상이 될 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: ArcGIS Server의 SQL 인젝션 취약점으로 인증되지 않은 공격자가 임의 데이터베이스 함수 실행 가능

CVE-2026-110720.description: Consul-k8s versions 0.42.0 and later are vulnerable to a cross-namespace authorization bypass in component ACL binding rules that may allow an attacker to obtain elevated Consul privileges. This vulnerability (CVE-2026-110720) is fixed in consul-k8s 2.1.0 and 1.8.18.
CVE-2026-110720.summary_ko: Consul-k8s의 ACL 바인딩 규칙에서 교차 네임스페이스 권한 우회 취약점이 확인되었습니다. 공격자는 이 결함을 이용해 Consul에 대한 상위 권한을 획득할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Consul-k8s의 ACL 바인딩 규칙 오류로 권한 우회 및 관리자 권한 획득 가능

CVE-2026-115905.description: zip is a zip library for Rust that supports reading and writing simple ZIP files. Through 9.0.4, ZipArchive treats Central Directory File Header filenames as authoritative while ZipStreamReader extracts using Local File Header filenames without reconciling the duplicate metadata in src/read/stream.rs. A crafted archive can therefore appear benign to a component that inspects the central directory but cause a streaming extractor to write a different attacker-selected path and content, potentially overwriting files used by a downstream service. This issue is fixed in version 9.0.5.
CVE-2026-115905.summary_ko: Rust용 zip 라이브러리가 중앙 디렉토리와 로컬 파일 헤더의 파일명 불일치를 검증하지 않습니다. 조작된 아카이브를 사용하면 서비스가 의도하지 않은 경로에 파일을 생성하거나 덮어쓰도록 유도할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Rust zip 라이브러리의 파일 경로 검증 미흡으로 아카이브 내 파일 경로 조작을 통한 임의 파일 쓰기 가능

CVE-2026-77055.description: boneIO black_debian_images gives the boneio service account excessive privileges, including full passwordless sudo access and membership in the docker group. A local attacker who compromises the boneio user can use these privileges to escalate to root. This issue was fixed in version 1.6.0: the image removes the sudoers rule and the docker group membership when it is sealed, and devices already in the field have both removed by migrations shipped with boneio 1.6.0 and applied on first start after the upgrade. Privileged operations now go through helpers that accept only a fixed set of commands, with migrations verified against Ed25519 signatures.
CVE-2026-77055.summary_ko: boneIO black_debian_images의 서비스 계정에 불필요하게 높은 sudo 및 도커 권한이 부여되어 있습니다. 로컬 공격자는 이를 악용하여 루트 권한으로 상승할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: boneIO Black 펌웨어의 서비스 권한 과다 설정으로 로컬 공격자가 루트 권한을 획득할 수 있는 취약점

CVE-2026-102649.description: Burrito is a Terraform Automation Collaboration Software (TACoS) Kubernetes operator. Prior to 0.13.0, `POST /api/webhook` accepts unsigned GitHub and GitLab events when a `TerraformRepository`'s credentials omit `webhookSecret` or set it to an empty value, including credentials configured for git authentication and polling. `Credential.WebhookSecret` is optional, and `go-playground/webhooks` skips signature or token verification when the secret is empty. Anyone who can reach `burrito-server`'s endpoint and knows a tracked repository's URL can forge events to create or delete `TerraformPullRequest` custom resources with attacker-chosen `Branch`, `Base`, and `ID` fields. For GitHub `pull_request` events, the controller fetches changed files using the real pull request number but does not cross-check the payload's branch against that pull request. Pairing a real, existing pull request number with an unrelated existing branch in the same repository can therefore cause an unauthorized `terraform plan` for affected layers using the operator's stored git and cloud credentials. Code analysis also indicates that the resulting plan can be posted to the real pull request's comment thread, exposing and misattributing another branch's infrastructure changes. Auto-apply is disabled for these temporary layers, so this vulnerability alone cannot force a `terraform apply`; plan-time provider and data-source code execution depends on the selected branch's contents. This issue is fixed in version 0.13.0.
CVE-2026-102649.summary_ko: Burrito 소프트웨어의 웹훅 API가 보안 비밀 키가 없을 경우 서명 확인 과정을 생략합니다. 공격자는 이를 이용해 허위 이벤트를 생성하고 권한 없는 원격 저장소의 인프라 변경을 유도할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Burrito의 웹훅 설정 미흡으로 인증 없이 원격에서 Pull Request 관련 자원 조작 및 계획 실행 가능

CVE-2026-65184.description: The root-privileged `wsserver` terminal-bridge daemon builds a shell command from client-supplied WebSocket fields and passes it to `system()` and `popen()` without quoting, escaping, or character-set validation. The daemon's public-key session path performs no appliance-session check.
CVE-2026-65184.summary_ko: 루트 권한으로 실행되는 wsserver 데몬이 외부 입력값을 검증 없이 셸 명령으로 처리합니다. 취약한 명령 처리 과정에서 입력값에 대한 적절한 이스케이프가 수행되지 않습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Avocent ACS8000의 명령 인젝션 취약점으로 원격 공격자가 루트 권한으로 시스템 명령 실행 가능

CVE-2026-116539.description: Netty netty-tcnative before 2.0.84.Final contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in the tcn_write_to_bytebuffer BIO callback caused by failing to wrap the non-application ring buffer write index. Remote TLS peers can drive handshake, renegotiation, or post-handshake messages into this buffer, triggering an out-of-bounds memcpy that crashes the JVM process.
CVE-2026-116539.summary_ko: Netty netty-tcnative의 BIO 콜백 함수에서 힙 버퍼 오버플로우가 발생합니다. 원격 TLS 피어는 악의적인 메시지를 통해 JVM 프로세스를 비정상적으로 종료시킬 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Netty tcnative의 힙 버퍼 오버플로우로 원격 TLS 피어가 서비스 중단(JVM 크래시) 유발 가능

CVE-2026-115912.description: vLLM is an inference and serving engine for large language models. Prior to 0.32.0, an authenticated caller can place forged shared-memory address and monotonic_id values in public multimodal features.kwargs_data. In scale-out deployments with shared-memory multimodal caching enabled, workers trust those values and pass attacker-selected bytes to pickle.loads(), allowing arbitrary Python execution even when insecure serialization is disabled. This issue is fixed in version 0.32.0.
CVE-2026-115912.summary_ko: vLLM 엔진에서 인증된 호출자가 조작된 공유 메모리 주소를 입력할 수 있는 취약점이 있습니다. 이를 통해 공격자는 임의의 파이썬 코드를 실행할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: vLLM의 직렬화 역직렬화 처리 결함으로 공격자가 임의 파이썬 코드를 실행할 수 있는 원격 실행 취약점

CVE-2026-116543.description: Open5GS 1.3.0 through 2.8.0 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in parse_multipart() that allows unauthenticated attackers to corrupt memory by supplying an empty multipart boundary. Attackers can send a single crafted multipart/related request to the SBI interface of any network function, overflowing the lookbehind buffer and crashing it.
CVE-2026-116543.summary_ko: Open5GS 네트워크 함수의 parse_multipart 함수에 힙 범위를 벗어난 쓰기 취약점이 존재합니다. 공격자는 조작된 멀티파트 요청을 보내 메모리를 손상시키고 서비스를 중단시킬 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Open5GS SBI 인터페이스의 힙 버퍼 오버플로우로 인증되지 않은 공격자가 서비스 중단 유발 가능

CVE-2026-116612.description: A flaw was found in GStreamer Editing Services (gst-editing-services). A GES project file can embed an arbitrary GStreamer pipeline description as an effect definition. When such a file is loaded, either explicitly by an editing application or automatically by a media player or file-manager thumbnailing service that uses GStreamer autoplugging, the pipeline description is parsed and instantiated without restriction on which elements may be used or which properties may be set. A remote attacker who can deliver a crafted project file to a victim's system can trigger reading or writing of arbitrary local files, issue outbound network requests to attacker-controlled servers, or cause the application to crash. Under certain conditions the file-write capability may be leveraged to achieve code execution.
CVE-2026-116612.summary_ko: GStreamer Editing Services 프로젝트 파일 로드 시 임의의 파이프라인 설명이 실행되어, 공격자가 로컬 파일 접근, 네트워크 요청 생성 또는 애플리케이션 충돌을 유발할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: GStreamer의 파이프라인 처리 결함으로 임의 로컬 파일 읽기/쓰기 및 코드 실행 가능

CVE-2026-116634.description: OmniRoute 3.8.50 before 3.8.52 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to issue sync tokens via POST /api/sync/tokens when requireLogin is disabled. Attackers can use the issued token against GET /api/sync/bundle to retrieve decrypted provider credentials and plaintext API keys, with tokens persisting after login is re-enabled.
CVE-2026-116634.summary_ko: OmniRoute에서 인증 우회 취약점으로 인해 인증되지 않은 공격자가 시스템 설정에 따라 제공자 자격 증명과 API 키를 탈취할 수 있는 토큰을 발행할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: OmniRoute의 인증 우회 취약점으로 공격자가 공급자 자격 증명과 API 키를 탈취 가능

CVE-2026-90885.description: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference vulnerability in Apache Camel Saxon component. This issue affects Apache Camel: from 4.0.0 before 4.18.5, from 4.19.0 before 4.22.2. XQueryBuilder in camel-saxon, which evaluates expressions for the xquery language and the xquery component, built its default Saxon Configuration with parse options that set only a whitespace stripping rule, leaving the XML parser at its defaults, under which a DOCTYPE declaration is accepted and external entities are resolved. A message body of type String or byte[], or any body read as an InputStream, is first turned into a javax.xml.transform.Source by Camel's own XML type converters, which configure the parser against external entities, so those bodies were not affected. A body that was already a Source, however, was handed to Saxon unchanged, and when that Source still had to be parsed, as a stream-based Source does, Saxon parsed it with that Configuration, bypassing the protection applied to the other body types. Such a body arises, for example, after a route converts the message with convertBodyTo(Source.class), or when a component or processor earlier in the route sets the body to a stream-based Source. A DOCTYPE with an external subset, or an external entity, declared in that body was therefore resolved and expanded into the document the expression was evaluated against. An external sender whose XML reaches an XQuery expression or an xquery endpoint in that form could read files readable by the Camel process and cause the process to issue requests to hosts the document names. No non-default option is required, since the default Configuration is used whenever the route does not supply one of its own. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 4.23.0, which fixes the issue. If users are on the 4.22.x releases stream, then they are suggested to upgrade to 4.22.2. If users are on the 4.18.x releases stream, then they are suggested to upgrade to 4.18.5. The 4.14.x releases stream and earlier, as well as the 4.15.x to 4.17.x and 4.19.x to 4.21.x release lines, reached end of life before this issue was resolved and will not receive a fix, so deployments on them must move to a supported release. For deployments that cannot upgrade immediately, do not evaluate XQuery over a message body that is already a javax.xml.transform.Source when that body carries XML from an untrusted sender, or set the configuration option of the xquery endpoint or language to a Saxon Configuration whose parse options refuse a DOCTYPE declaration and disable external entities and external DTD loading, which is what the fixed releases now apply by default.
CVE-2026-90885.summary_ko: Apache Camel의 Saxon 컴포넌트에서 XML 외부 엔티티 처리 미흡으로 인해 공격자가 민감한 파일 읽기 및 외부 서버로의 요청을 유발할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Apache Camel의 XXE 취약점으로 외부 개체 처리로 인한 데이터 유출 가능

CVE-2026-116638.description: The Windows Recovery Environment (WinRE) in Windows 10 and 11 may allow an attacker to bypass firmware security controls, including administrator-configured UEFI/BIOS passwords. An attacker with physical or administrative access to a device may be able to leverage WinRE-related boot mechanisms to circumvent firmware protections and gain unauthorized access to system resources.
CVE-2026-116638.summary_ko: Windows 복구 환경(WinRE)에서 부팅 메커니즘을 이용해 펌웨어 보안 제어를 우회하고 장치 리소스에 무단 접근할 수 있는 취약점이 존재합니다.

curation.reason_ko: Windows 복구 환경(WinRE)을 이용한 펌웨어 보안 제어 우회 및 시스템 리소스 무단 접근 가능

CVE-2026-115922.description: Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) is an open standard for machine learning interoperability. Prior to 1.22.0, _unpack_2bit() and _unpack_4bit() resize unpacked arrays according to attacker-controlled TensorProto.dims without verifying that raw_data or int32_data encodes the declared number of elements. Materializing an untrusted UINT2, INT2, UINT4, INT4, or FLOAT4E2M1 tensor through onnx.numpy_helper.to_array() or onnx.reference.ReferenceEvaluator can therefore expand a small packed payload into a disproportionately large allocation and exhaust memory. This issue is fixed in version 1.22.0.
CVE-2026-115922.summary_ko: ONNX에서 텐서 데이터의 크기를 검증하지 않아 공격자가 조작된 페이로드를 통해 메모리를 과도하게 할당하고 고갈시킬 수 있는 취약점이 존재합니다.

curation.reason_ko: ONNX 데이터 처리 로직의 메모리 할당 결함으로 대규모 패딩을 이용한 서비스 거부 공격 가능

CVE-2026-115679.description: Arm Keil MDK-Middleware 8.3.0 may allow out-of-bounds reads and writes to the FTP Server RX Buffer
CVE-2026-115679.summary_ko: Arm Keil MDK-Middleware 8.3.0에서 FTP 서버 RX 버퍼에 대한 범위를 벗어난 읽기 및 쓰기 취약점이 확인되었습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Arm Keil MDK-Middleware의 FTP 서버 Rx 버퍼에 대한 OOB 읽기 및 쓰기 취약점

CVE-2026-92171.description: A flaw was found in the Infinispan Operator for Red Hat Data Grid. When cross-site (xsite) TLS is enabled, the operator launches the Gossip Router container with keystore and truststore passwords passed as plain-text command-line arguments (`-tls_keystore_password`, `-tls_truststore_password`). Container args are stored in the Pod spec and visible to any principal with `get pods` permission in the namespace (no `get secrets` required), to node-level processes via `/proc/<pid>/cmdline`, and frequently captured in audit/event logs.
CVE-2026-92171.summary_ko: Red Hat Data Grid용 Infinispan Operator가 TLS 인증서 비밀번호를 일반 텍스트 명령줄 인수로 노출하여 네임스페이스 내 권한 보유자가 이를 확인할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Red Hat Data Grid Operator의 TLS 키스토어 비밀번호가 평문 인자로 저장되어 정보 노출 위험

CVE-2026-116497.description: A NULL pointer dereference vulnerability was found in gssproxy. When a GSSX_INIT_SEC_CONTEXT request is received with the target_name field absent, the daemon dereferences the resulting NULL pointer and crashes. The request requires no authentication, allowing any local user to crash the gssproxy daemon via its Unix socket. The daemon does not automatically restart, resulting in a persistent denial of service that also affects dependent services such as Kerberized NFS and IdM.
CVE-2026-116497.summary_ko: gssproxy에서 target_name 필드가 없는 GSSX_INIT_SEC_CONTEXT 요청을 처리할 때 NULL 포인터 역참조로 인해 데몬이 중단되는 서비스 거부 취약점이 발생합니다.

curation.reason_ko: gssproxy의 NULL 포인터 역참조 취약점으로 로컬 사용자 기반의 지속적 서비스 거부 공격 가능

43bc421ee81ebd4e4048cd35.summary_ko: 오픈AI가 적극적인 가격 할인과 무료 크레딧을 앞세워 기업 고객 확보에 나선 가운데, 앤트로픽은 고성능 신모델 출시를 통해 점유율을 방어하며 치열한 경쟁을 벌이고 있습니다. 고객사들은 가격 경쟁력과 모델 성능을 바탕으로 서비스 제공업체를 유연하게 변경하고 있어 향후 경쟁 구도는 더욱 복잡해질 전망입니다.

7b2b6a1017ee4e610c3d8f4f.summary_ko: 이디오그램(Ideogram)이 텍스트로 설명하면 SVG 파일을 생성하거나 기존 이미지를 벡터로 변환하는 AI 모델 ‘이디오그램 벡터’를 공개했습니다. 이 도구는 로고나 일러스트 등 디자인 작업 시 해상도 제약 없이 수정이 가능하며, 개발자를 위한 API 연동 기능도 함께 지원합니다.

de64a2c0660129438f5fbafe.title_original: Tradeoff-Aware Territory Design: A Multi-Objective Decision System for Enterprise Customer-to-Seller Allocation
de64a2c0660129438f5fbafe.excerpt: arXiv:2610.31701v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Enterprise customer journeys are shaped not only by product experiences and marketing, but also by recurring resource-allocation decisions. In B2B go-to-market (GTM) organizations, territory carving determines which accounts receive seller coverage, which seller-account relationships are preserved, and how limited field capacity is distributed. Yet the process often remains manual, making it difficult to compare opportunities, value continuity, and evaluate tradeoffs among growth, balance, capacity, and feasibility. We present a production decision system for tradeoff-aware customer-to-seller allocation in enterprise GTM planning. It integrates three components: a multidimensional account-value layer that combines predictive signals to score opportunity; an observational continuity-valuation layer that estimates the cost of breaking seller-account relationships using a synthetic-control-style counterfactual framework; and a multi-objective optimization layer that allocates coverage to high-value accounts while considering continuity, opportunity balance, and operational constraints. Deployed as a scenario-based decision-support system, the framework enables planners to inspect and compare allocation tradeoffs. Historical backtesting shows that optimizer-generated scenarios substantially improve assignment compliance while maintaining comparable seller-level opportunity distribution. 6c94ef1ceb24a929b79b5f16.title_original: Phronix: The Capability-Centric Learning Paradigm for Agents
6c94ef1ceb24a929b79b5f16.excerpt: arXiv:2610.31789v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Scientific computing increasingly relies on large language model-based agents for performance engineering tasks such as instrumentation, analysis, and workflow porting. However, agent effectiveness depends heavily on the surrounding harness, which typically relies on manually written skills and curated memory. This limits autonomous learning, forcing agents to repeatedly rediscover solutions rather than retain and reuse knowledge from prior executions. We introduce Phronix, a capability-centric learning paradigm that enables agentic harnesses to acquire, validate, and refine reusable capabilities from their own executions. Phronix operates through a predictor-validator-corrector loop: MCP tools and associated skills propose solutions, tool executions validate them, and observed outcomes refine the stored capabilities. It distills every observed interaction into a capability store and researches a failing task rather than abandoning it. First, such learned capabilities solve a recurring task on the first attempt in 93-95% of cases across every model, significantly reducing solution non-determinism and improving reliability. Second, Phronix turns an agent's own execution into 7.6-30.8 durable capabilities per task without user instruction, and creation falls below two once the needed capability exists. 41c43a98db8b600e848d524c.title_original: Patronizing and Condescending Language Detection in English and Mandarin
41c43a98db8b600e848d524c.excerpt: arXiv:2610.31808v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Patronizing and condescending language (PCL) is a form of harmful language that belittles and assumes pity for vulnerable groups, reinforcing negative societal stereotypes. However, unlike overt hate speech, it is often difficult to detect, even for human judges. This paper proposes a system for the automated detection of PCL. Our first approach uses static word embeddings and a convolutional neural network for classification, while our second approach uses pre-trained BERT embeddings fine-tuned for the PCL task. Our second approach was considerably more successful, and achieved an F1 score of 0.528 over the development set.

7707b513bdd24c5e42c30071.title_original: PaperFormalizer: Author-in-the-Loop Autoformalization of Research Papers in Lean
7707b513bdd24c5e42c30071.excerpt: arXiv:2610.31810v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Even a carefully proofread paper can leave small gaps in its proofs or its stated assumptions. We introduce PaperFormalizer, a Lean-based agentic pipeline that helps authors find and close such gaps in their own papers and turn each paper into a Lean-verified version. Starting from the LaTeX source, PaperFormalizer transcribes the paper into a dependency graph of statements, audits each statement in natural language for faithfulness, ambiguity and correctness, and then formalizes and proves the statements in Lean against Mathlib, optional domain libraries and the author's personal toolkit. Only the author knows what a statement is meant to say and how a formalization gap in a result is best fixed. The pipeline therefore stops and asks the author whenever a statement admits more than one reading, presents every repair, in natural language and TeX symbols, as a proposal that the author can accept, decline or redirect, and leaves to the author every decision that could potentially change what the paper claims. The output is an annotated and revised version of the paper, a report of the changes, and Lean code in which each declaration is linked to the statement it formalizes. The author's toolkit grows as more papers are formalized, and authors can share their verified papers so that researchers who build on them can reuse their Lean code. afa3feb2d46d3a190126b65e.title_original: Don't Forget What You Just Learned: Self-Directed Repair Turns Agent Mistakes Into Lasting Lessons
afa3feb2d46d3a190126b65e.excerpt: arXiv:2610.31846v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Intelligent agents should learn from their mistakes so that experience leads to continuous improvement. Yet today's agents recover from a mistake only temporarily: in-context reflections are easily forgotten across sessions and compete for limited context, while full-parameter fine-tuning is expensive and can interfere with existing capabilities. We introduce Self-Direction, a mechanism for agents to learn from mistakes that combines the benefits of temporary in-context retries and policy updates. When an agent fails a task, it reflects on its own trajectory in order to extract a lesson and immediately distills it into a lightweight low-rank adapter. By keeping the original weights frozen, Self-Direction prevents adapter training from overwriting base-model parameters while training additional parameters equivalent to ~0.02% of the base model's parameter count for each adapter. The agent then saves these adapters in a persistent library of lessons, automatically routing them to solve related problems later. Experiments with agents based on open-weight models from the Qwen family across open-ended research (GAIA), tool-use workflows (Claw-Eval), and terminal tasks (Terminal-Bench 2.1) show that our method improves overall success rates by 8.9 to 17.0 percentage points and performs competitively with frontier systems. 4870baa954853b2a730945a7.title_original: TACS-RF: Tool-driven Agentic Circuit Synthesis of RF and mmWave Modules
4870baa954853b2a730945a7.excerpt: arXiv:2610.31882v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present the framework of TACS-RF - a Tool-driven Agentic Circuit Synthesis of RF and mmWave modules. In this framework, a large-language-model (LLM) coding agent (Claude Opus 4.8) directly drives industry-standard electronic-design-automation (EDA) tools such as Cadence Virtuoso/Spectre, Calibre, Cadence EMX, and Ansys HFSS to design RF and mmWave modules. We validate the framework through the agentic design of a 240-251 GHz sub-THz transmitter in a 90 nm SiGe BiCMOS process. The agent semi-autonomously designed the sub-blocks including a 60 GHz push-push Colpitts VCO with second-harmonic extraction, multistage differential cascode power drivers, a push-push frequency doubler, a differential bowtie antenna, and all the interstage matching networks. The transmitter chain with parasitic-extracted devices and EM-verified passives delivers +5.1 to +6.3 dBm across an 11 GHz varactor-only tuning range, phase noise of -80 to -88 dBc/Hz at 1 MHz offset while consuming a DC power of 361 mW. We describe the agent-driven design flow and the resulting division of labor between human and agent, taking a step toward a "text-to-ASIC" future for designing RF/mmWave hardware.

50418d0b14b3c64f2e57e1ec.title_original: Permission to Retry: A Study of Authorization and Recovery in AI Agent Workflows
50418d0b14b3c64f2e57e1ec.excerpt: arXiv:2610.31916v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A durable agent can resume a consequential action while its authority changes and the action's external outcome remains uncertain. We study execution-time reliability of tool-using AI agents, isolating recovery decisions from language-model behavior. Checkpoint state, permission to dispatch, evidence of an external effect and permission to reconcile are distinct obligations. We present a finite conformance study that checks these obligations through histories scored against a provider effect ledger hidden from the recovering application. A prospectively frozen campaign executes 336 histories on native LangGraph and Temporal hosts, crossing 14 schedules, three provider contracts and four matched application policies. All 168 paired host cells have identical checked outcomes. Per host, retained-ledger reconciliation passes all 42 histories: 21 checked completions, 15 denials and six unknown outcomes with reservations retained. Cached retry, revalidation before retry and stable-key retry pass 30, 36 and 31 histories respectively. A separate 16-case component study of InfinityOS, an enterprise AI platform developed by Arya.ai, exercises exported authority, worker, recovery and settlement code over repository fakes. The results isolate the roles of current authority, provider contracts and retained observations in recovery, with safety, completion and unresolved obligations reported separately for the declared application profile.

587ea142704a5faa8a027981.excerpt: arXiv:2610.31918v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Distilling interactive LLM agents requires choosing between teacher-generated demonstrations and student-generated experience, corresponding broadly to off-policy and on-policy distillation. While both have proven effective, we argue that this distinction is inherently hierarchical: the policy that induces an interaction history need not be the same as the policy that generates the token prefix of the current action. We introduce a hierarchical agent distillation framework that formalizes these two levels of on-policiness and enables explicit control over their pairing, mixture proportions, and training schedule. We find that student-induced histories paired with teacher-generated action prefixes generally provide the strongest standalone training signal, whereas following the student at both levels generally performs worst. Nevertheless, fully on-policy data becomes beneficial when incorporated into a mixture with other configurations.
