This allows an attacker to read arbitrary files accessible to the openEQUELLA service or cause the server to issue requests to attacker-specified locations (SSRF).

CVE-2026-66090.description: In openEQUELLA before 2026.1, the XML parser used for item metadata does not disable external entity resolution. A user permitted to create items (CREATE_ITEM) can submit crafted XML to POST /api/item and cause the server to read arbitrary files accessible to the openEQUELLA service, or make requests to attacker-specified locations (SSRF), including cloud instance metadata services.

CVE-2026-66091.description: In openEQUELLA before 2026.1, the GET /api/userquery/userinfobackup endpoint performs no authentication or authorisation check. An unauthenticated attacker who supplies another user's uniqueId can retrieve that user's stored personal details (username, first name, last name and email address) within the same institution.

CVE-2026-66092.description: In openEQUELLA before 2026.2, the pre-login notice is stored as HTML and rendered on the legacy logon page without encoding or sanitisation. A user holding the EDIT_SYSTEM_SETTINGS permission can set a notice containing an arbitrary script (PUT /api/preloginnotice), resulting in stored cross-site scripting on the login page. Unauthenticated exploitation is possible where EDIT_SYSTEM_SETTINGS has been granted to the guest user or Everyone

CVE-2026-109516.description: The Bot for Telegram on WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authentication Bypass leading to Account Takeover in all versions up to, and including, 1.3.0. The `/wp-json/woo-telegram/v1/main/` REST endpoint is registered with `permission_callback => '__return_true'` and performs no Telegram webhook signature verification, allowing an unauthenticated attacker to POST a forged bot update with a `message.chat.id` set to any WordPress login name; `bftow_get_user_system_id()` resolves this attacker-supplied value to the targeted account via `get_user_by('login', $tgId)` with no ownership proof, and writes a login token computed as `md5($_SERVER['HTTP_USER_AGENT'] . time())` — both inputs are fully attacker-controlled or bounded within seconds using the response's own `Date` header. The resulting token is redeemable at the unauthenticated, capability-check-free, and nonce-less `?action=bftow_create_order&bftow_token=` endpoint, which calls `wp_set_auth_cookie()` unconditionally via `login_user_by_id`, issuing a persistent authenticated session cookie for the targeted account to the attacker. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to log in as any WordPress user, including administrators, given only that user's username.
CVE-2026-109516.summary_ko: WordPress용 Bot for Telegram 플러그인에서 인증 우회 및 계정 탈취 취약점이 발견되었습니다. 공격자가 인증 없이 REST 엔드포인트를 통해 사용자 세션 쿠키를 생성하여 관리자를 포함한 모든 사용자로 로그인할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-118426.description: In affected versions of Octopus Server with the LDAP authentication provider enabled, any authenticated user could call the LDAP user search and LDAP group search.

CVE-2026-40063.description: A information disclosure vulnerability exists in the /nodered/fuxa/scripts functionality of FUXA (version(s): 1.3.2-2809). A specially crafted HTTP request can lead to an information leak. An attacker can make an unauthenticated HTTP request to trigger this vulnerability.

CVE-2026-42922.description: A authorization bypass vulnerability exists in the /nodered functionality of FUXA (version(s): 1.3.2-2809). A specially crafted HTTP request can lead to a arbitrary code execution. An attacker can make an unauthenticated HTTP request to trigger this vulnerability.
CVE-2026-42922.summary_ko: FUXA 1.3.2-2809 버전의 /nodered 기능에서 인증 우회 및 임의 코드 실행 취약점이 발견되었습니다. 공격자는 인증되지 않은 HTTP 요청을 보내 취약점을 실행할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-42949.description: A authorization bypass vulnerability exists in the /api/runscript functionality of FUXA (version(s): 1.3.2-2809). A specially crafted HTTP request can lead to execute priviledged operation. An attacker can make an unauthenticated HTTP request to trigger this vulnerability.

CVE-2026-93757.description: The Wild Apricot Login plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authentication Bypass via SSO Email-Collision Account Binding in all versions up to, and including, 1.0.18. When no WildApricot contact-ID mapping is found for an incoming SSO login, the plugin falls back to a network-global `get_user_by('email', ...)` lookup in `Module.php` to resolve a WordPress user, then `UserSynchronizer::syncWaContact()` binds and `Controller::login()` issues a session cookie via `wp_set_auth_cookie()` for that resolved user — both guarded only by `is_super_admin()` — without ever requiring proof of ownership of the matched WordPress account such as a password, local account-linking confirmation, inbox verification, or administrator approval. This makes it possible for attackers with custom-level WildApricot membership access to authenticate as an existing WordPress subsite administrator on a path-based Multisite network, obtaining a valid network-global authentication cookie for the victim without their credentials. Exploitation requires that the attacker control a WildApricot contact whose email address matches the target WordPress administrator's email — achievable via a public zero-fee membership application on the connected WildApricot organization — and that they complete the SSO flow on any subsite where Wild Apricot Login is active; because WordPress user identities and authentication cookies are network-global, the cookie issued on that subsite is equally valid on any other subsite where the victim user holds an administrator role.

CVE-2026-93855.description: The SendPress Newsletters plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to time-based SQL Injection via the 'subscriberid' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.26.1.20 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database. The nonce gating the handler uses the hardcoded action value 'sendpress-is-awesome', which is rendered on the same public page served by the [sp-form formid="manage"] shortcode, making it trivially obtainable by unauthenticated visitors and effectively bypassing the nonce as an access control.

CVE-2026-93904.description: The Social Web Suite – Social Media Auto Post, Social Media Auto Publish plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to generic SQL Injection via the 'exclude_posts' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.1.12 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database. The HMAC authentication gate protecting the endpoint is bypassable on any freshly activated installation where an administrator has not yet visited the settings page, because the secret_key option remains empty until lazily generated at that point, allowing an attacker to compute a valid token using hash_hmac('sha256', '', $timestamp) with any chosen timestamp.

CVE-2026-96228.description: SSL Wireless SMS Notification for WordPress is vulnerable to Authentication Bypass in all versions up to, and including, 3.8.1. The public final_login_ajax_action handler resolves a user and issues an authenticated session by matching the wp_sslcare_otp table on only the attacker-supplied phone and cap_data, without verifying the SMS OTP or any server-side single-use state. Because cap_data was chosen by the attacker in the public otp_login_ajax_action step (which stores the row before sending the SMS), the finalize step trivially matches and the user is looked up solely by the sslcare_login_phone meta. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers who know a phone-linked user's number to take over that account.

CVE-2026-96666.description: The Schema App Structured Data plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via Comment Content via 'Remove Microdata' Output Filter in all versions up to, and including, 2.3.2 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires that an administrator has enabled the plugin's 'Remove Microdata' option and approves the malicious comment.

CVE-2026-96669.description: The Food Store – Online Food Delivery & Pickup plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via 'service_type' Cookie in all versions up to, and including, 1.5.5 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The attack is seeded unauthenticated by supplying a payload via the ?type= query parameter on the public checkout page, which the plugin writes directly into the browser's service_type cookie; this cookie value is later persisted to order meta and rendered unescaped in the admin panel.

CVE-2026-96741.description: The DSGVO All in one for WP plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via Comment Content via Output Buffer Regex Corruption in all versions up to, and including, 5.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This is only exploitable when the administrator has enabled both the 'Google Tag Manager' integration and the 'Replace integration automatically [Beta]' option, and requires the crafted comment to be approved by an administrator.

CVE-2024-3586.description: The LetterPress WordPress plugin before 2.4.0 does not sanitise and escape some of its settings, which could allow high privilege users such as admin to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks even when the unfiltered_html capability is disallowed (for example in multisite setup)

CVE-2026-103693.description: The Frontend Dashboard WordPress plugin before 3.0.5, ProfileGrid WordPress plugin before 6.0.0.5 do not prevent an unauthenticated user from storing a serialized PHP object in user metadata that is deserialized when a public profile is viewed, allowing PHP object injection that can lead to arbitrary file write and potential remote code execution.

CVE-2026-105258.description: The Appointment Booking Plugin WordPress plugin before 5.7.6 does not escape several booking-form step content settings before rendering them on the public booking form, allowing high-privilege users such as administrators to inject JavaScript that executes in the browser of any visitor who loads the form; on multisite, where administrators do not hold the unfiltered_html capability, this crosses a privilege boundary to unauthenticated visitors.

CVE-2026-108685.description: The WP Post Author WordPress plugin before 4.2.0 does not check that the account was created before updating its profile during front-end registration, allowing unauthenticated users to overwrite the display name, nickname and website of the first user account, which is normally the administrator, when a registration form declares one of those fields.

CVE-2026-108686.description: The WP Post Author WordPress plugin before 4.2.0 does not restrict the integration settings it returns to visitors, allowing unauthenticated users to read the reCAPTCHA secret key when one has been saved.

CVE-2026-108763.description: The Wallet System for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 2.8.2 does not restrict its KYC document submission handler to the current user's own account, taking the target user ID from a client-supplied request field with no ownership or capability check, allowing authenticated users with minimal privileges such as Subscriber or Customer to overwrite the KYC documents and verification status of any other user, including an administrator.

CVE-2026-110030.description: The Hide Price Until Login WordPress plugin before 1.1.2 does not restrict a guest-registration handler and does not honour the site's user-registration setting, allowing anyone to create a WordPress account and obtain a logged-in session even when registration is disabled.

CVE-2026-110504.description: The Enable SVG, WebP, and ICO Upload WordPress plugin before 1.1.6 does not sanitize uploaded SVG files whose content is not detected as SVG, while still storing and serving them as SVG images, which could allow users with the author role and above to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks.

CVE-2026-110505.description: The Enable SVG, WebP, and ICO Upload WordPress plugin before 1.1.6 does not prevent animation elements in uploaded SVG files from changing a link's target to a javascript: URI, which could allow users with the author role and above to bypass its SVG sanitization and perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks that execute in WebKit-based browsers such as Safari.

CVE-2026-110983.description: The WP Photo Album Plus WordPress plugin before 9.3.04.004 does not verify the origin or a security token for one of its comment-management requests, allowing attackers to delete photo comments by tricking a logged-in user who holds comment-moderation rights into loading a crafted page.

CVE-2026-111739.description: The Two Factor Authentication WordPress plugin before 1.17.0, All-In-One Security (AIOS) WordPress plugin before 5.5.0 do not bind the account whose two-factor code is verified to the account being authenticated, allowing an attacker who knows a victim's password and holds their own two-factor-enabled account to satisfy the victim's second-factor check with their own code and obtain the victim's session.

CVE-2026-113616.description: The LogixFast Auth WordPress plugin before 1.0.4 does not deliver its password-reset one-time code to the resolved account's own email address, mailing it to the address supplied in the request instead, allowing unauthenticated attackers to reset any user's password, including an administrator's, and take over the account.

CVE-2026-113617.description: The Automated Import Products to Cart WordPress plugin before 1.0.4 does not sanitize a user-supplied file path before using it to read and delete files, allowing users with minimal permissions, such as subscribers, to read arbitrary files (including ones containing the database credentials) and delete arbitrary files on the server.

CVE-2026-114270.description: The GeoDirectory WordPress plugin before 2.8.197 does not honour post password protection when rendering a listing, allowing unauthenticated users to disclose the content and custom fields of published listings that are protected by a post password.

CVE-2026-114488.description: A flaw was found in Wildfly. A remote attacker can bypass authentication on IIOP EJB invocations as the CSIv2 security interceptor accepts ITTPrincipalName identity assertions in the service context without verifying transport-level authentication, allowing a pre-auth attacker on the port 3528 to impersonate any principal on every IIOP-exposed @Remote EJB.

CVE-2026-115245.description: The Chat AI with Dispatcher WordPress plugin before 2.4 does not properly validate uploaded files, relying only on a spoofable client-supplied content type, allowing unauthenticated attackers to upload arbitrary files, including PHP, which can lead to remote code execution.

CVE-2026-115259.description: The Photo Engine (Media Organizer & Lightroom) WordPress plugin before 6.6.0 does not have proper authorization checks when updating post data through one of its REST API routes in all versions up to, and including, 6.5.8. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Author-level access and above, to modify the title, content, excerpt and other fields of arbitrary posts, pages and attachments, including those belonging to other users.

CVE-2026-115282.description: The Recipe Card Blocks Lite WordPress plugin before 3.6.4 does not perform an authorization check before rendering posts through its recipe print feature, allowing unauthenticated users to disclose the title, ID and recipe content of unpublished posts, including drafts, pending, private and password-protected posts, that contain a recipe card block. Its optional "print only published posts" protection does not prevent this, because the status check is applied to a different post than the one ultimately rendered.

CVE-2026-115299.description: The Contact Form by Supsystic WordPress plugin before 1.11.1 does not verify a CSRF nonce before saving its mail settings, allowing an attacker to overwrite the site's outbound mail configuration, including the SMTP server, its credentials and the notification recipient, by tricking a logged-in administrator into visiting a crafted page, which can route the Contact Form by Supsystic WordPress plugin before 1.11.1's contact-form notifications through infrastructure the attacker controls.

CVE-2026-115300.description: The Contact Form by Supsystic WordPress plugin before 1.11.1 does not validate a CSRF token or request origin on two administrator-only actions that bulk-delete captured form submissions and wipe a form's statistics, allowing attackers to permanently destroy a site's stored contact leads and analytics by tricking a logged-in administrator into sending a forged request.

CVE-2026-115301.description: The Contact Form by Supsystic WordPress plugin before 1.11.1 does not sandbox the template engine used to render its forms and allows stored form-editor content to reach that engine as executable template code, enabling an administrator to perform server-side template injection and execute arbitrary code on the server. The injected template is compiled and executed whenever any visitor loads a page containing the form, so the stored payload also lets an unauthenticated visitor read server-side secrets such as authentication salts and database credentials.

CVE-2026-115302.description: The Contact Form by Supsystic WordPress plugin before 1.11.1 does not restrict access to an AJAX action that deletes stored form statistics records, allowing unauthenticated attackers to delete arbitrary statistics entries.

CVE-2026-118905.description: Node Version Manager (nvm) is a POSIX-compliant shell function for managing multiple node.js versions. In versions 0.31.2 through 0.40.5, `nvm_ls` filters installed versions with a sed program that embeds the requested version pattern in a `\#...#` address, escaping `.` (and, since 0.40.4, `#`) but not backslash. A version string containing `#` (or `\#`) therefore closes the address early, and the rest of it is parsed as sed commands: with GNU sed, the `e` command runs a shell command as the user; with BSD sed, the `w` and `r` commands write and read files. This is reachable whenever an attacker-influenced version string is passed to `nvm use`, `nvm which`, `nvm ls`, `nvm version`, `nvm run`, or `nvm exec`, or to `nvm-exec` via `NODE_VERSION`, and at least one version is installed. nvm's own `.nvmrc` parser strips comments, so a bare `nvm use` is not affected; however, the bash `cdnvm` and zsh `load-nvmrc` auto-switch hooks documented in the README read `.nvmrc` as-is and pass it to `nvm ls` and `nvm version`, so a user with one of those hooks installed runs the attacker's command just by changing into a directory under a malicious `.nvmrc`; scripts that run `nvm use "$(cat .nvmrc)"` are affected the same way. Version 0.40.6 passes any version pattern containing `#` or a newline through the `.nvmrc` content parser first, so no `#` reaches the sed program.
CVE-2026-118905.summary_ko: Node Version Manager(nvm)의 버전 필터링 로직에서 sed 명령어를 이용한 임의 코드 실행 취약점이 발견되었습니다. 악의적으로 조작된 버전 문자열을 통해 로컬 환경에서 공격자가 명령을 실행할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-15564.description: Wildfly's IIOP listener may permit deserialization of input streams before authentication is performed. An attacker who can gain access to the IIOP port may be able to construct and send malicious objects and achieve deserialization, if the target EJB allows untyped method parameters, and depending on the potential gadget chains available in the running classpath.

CVE-2026-19610.description: A flaw was found in the platform-mbean component of JBoss EAP, which provides management access to JVM-level metrics and configurations. The issue occurs because the handler for the read-resource operation on the runtime management resource fails to perform required Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) checks. This allows an authenticated user with low-privileged access, such as the Monitor role, to view sensitive system properties and JVM configuration details that should be restricted.

CVE-2026-78395.description: The Link Library WordPress plugin before 7.10.0 does not re-check the selected library's own login requirement when processing its front-end link submission, allowing unauthenticated users to submit links to a library configured to require login by reusing a form token obtained from another library that does not.

CVE-2026-78396.description: The Link Library WordPress plugin before 7.10.0 does not verify that a requested link belongs to the settings set whose display template is used to render it, allowing unauthenticated users to disclose the telephone number, e-mail address and submitter name stored with links that the settings set is configured not to display.

CVE-2026-85007.description: The Video Player for YouTube WordPress plugin before 2.1.4 does not perform a capability check on its player-preset AJAX handler, allowing users with the Contributor role and above to read the site-wide player-preset configuration, and in versions before 2.1.1 to modify and delete it as well.

CVE-2026-86794.description: The Community Events WordPress plugin before 1.6.0 does not have authorisation or nonce checks when processing public event submissions, and does not escape several of the submitted values before outputting them in the administration dashboard and on the public calendar, allowing unauthenticated users to inject arbitrary web scripts that will execute in the browser of an administrator reviewing the submission.

CVE-2026-88928.description: The PAYCOMET for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 5.46 does not verify the cryptographic signature on its payment notification endpoint when the request references a tokenisation operation, allowing unauthenticated attackers to overwrite the stored payment token associated with existing orders and delete saved card records.

CVE-2026-89216.description: The vTables WordPress plugin before 0.3 does not properly sanitise and escape a parameter before using it in a SQL statement, which allows unauthenticated attackers to perform SQL injection attacks and extract data from the database.

CVE-2026-93293.description: The Password Protected plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the bundled Freemius SDK's purchase-completion handler in all versions up to, and including, 2.8.4 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. Once the site's Freemius opt-in is complete (the normal state after an administrator clicks "Allow & Continue"), the handler processes the 'purchased_plan' request parameter on any wp-admin request from an authenticated user without any capability, nonce, or purchase validation, and stores it in a persistent, site-wide administrative notice. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts that execute automatically when an administrator views a standard admin page such as their Profile page.

CVE-2026-117548.description: A NULL pointer dereference flaw was found in 389-ds-base. This flaw occurs when a ModifyDN (rename) operation uses an attribute's schema alias name (such as "commonName") instead of its canonical name (such as "cn") as the new relative distinguished name. An authenticated attacker with the ModifyDN (rename) permission on the affected entry can use this flaw to crash the directory server, causing a denial of service.

CVE-2026-117627.description: A flaw was found in the JWT Authorization Grant implementation of the keycloak-services component. When an OIDC or Google identity provider is configured with specific login restrictions, such as claim filtering, these checks are correctly applied during standard browser logins but are skipped during the JWT-based grant flow. This allows an authenticated client to obtain access tokens for a user even if their identity provider claims should have blocked the login.

CVE-2026-117688.description: A flaw was found in the client registration component of Keycloak, an open-source identity and access management solution. When a vault provider is used to store sensitive information, an authenticated client owner can use a specially crafted reference to trick the system into revealing secrets. By updating a client secret to point to a vault entry and then requesting the client configuration, the owner can see the secret value in plain text. This could lead to the exposure of sensitive credentials that the user should not be able to access.

CVE-2026-117859.description: A flaw was found in the Pushed Authorization Request PAR implementation of the keycloak-services component. The issue occurs when an authentication flow is restarted, which incorrectly clears the internal markers used to track PAR consumption while leaving the request active. This allows an attacker to reuse the same authorization request to obtain multiple access tokens, bypassing security requirements for single-use requests.

CVE-2026-118030.description: A flaw was found in the HOTP authentication mechanism of the keycloak-services component, which provides identity and access management services. The issue occurs because the system validates a one-time password and updates its internal counter in two separate steps without proper locking. An attacker with a users password could exploit this timing gap to use a single one-time code to log in multiple times simultaneously.

CVE-2025-62839.description: An use of hard-coded cryptographic key vulnerability has been reported to affect HBS 3 Hybrid Backup Sync and Hybrid Backup Sync. If exploited, the vulnerability could allow remote attackers to compromise the security of the system. We have already fixed the vulnerability in the following version: HBS 3 Hybrid Backup Sync 26.4.0.521 and later Hybrid Backup Sync 26.4.0.521 and later Hybrid Backup Sync 26.4.1.563 and later
CVE-2025-62839.summary_ko: HBS 3 Hybrid Backup Sync 및 Hybrid Backup Sync 제품에서 하드코딩된 암호화 키 사용 취약점이 발견되었습니다. 이를 통해 원격 공격자가 시스템 보안을 침해할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2025-62841.description: An use of hard-coded cryptographic key vulnerability has been reported to affect HBS 3 Hybrid Backup Sync and Hybrid Backup Sync. If exploited, the vulnerability could allow remote attackers to compromise the security of the system. We have already fixed the vulnerability in the following version: HBS 3 Hybrid Backup Sync 26.4.0.521 and later Hybrid Backup Sync 26.4.0.521 and later Hybrid Backup Sync 26.4.1.563 and later

CVE-2026-114358.description: This vulnerability exists in the Radius Xenia M2M Platform due to insufficient validation of user supplied input in the password recovery functionality in the web management interface. An unauthenticated remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability by supplying crafted SQL query through input fields to the targeted system. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow the attacker to gain unauthorized access to sensitive information, enumerate database structure or modify database records on the targeted system.

CVE-2026-115303.description: The Contact Form by Supsystic WordPress plugin before 1.11.1 does not strip CR/LF characters or re-validate submitted field values before concatenating them into outgoing email headers when a form is configured to map a submitted field into its Reply-To, From or Cc header, allowing unauthenticated users to inject arbitrary email headers such as additional Bcc or Cc recipients into the notification email.

CVE-2026-7190.description: A cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the ICTBroadcast software, which affects the demo environment. The vulnerability is found in the ‘login.php’ endpoint, where the ‘editForm[extension_username]’ parameter is reflected in the response without proper filtering. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary JavaScript code in the victim’s browser once the victim accesses the malicious URL.

CVE-2026-85498.description: A flaw was found in polkit. When processing input that begins with a null byte, an arithmetic error in the authentication agent helper causes an integer underflow during buffer length calculation, resulting in an out-of-bounds memory read. An attacker capable of supplying crafted input can trigger this flaw, potentially causing an application crash and resulting in a Denial of Service (DoS).

CVE-2026-103485.description: The Extensions for Leaflet Map plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via the 'feature.properties[<template-token>]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 5.4 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires that a site administrator has previously configured a public map using the [leaflet-map]+[leaflet-geojson]+[choropleth] shortcode combination whose GeoJSON src URL is one the attacker controls — for example, through compromise of an external data host, a subdomain takeover, or a site intentionally pointing at an attacker-hosted feed.

CVE-2026-103875.description: The Media Library Assistant plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Reflected Cross-Site Scripting via the 'search-string' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.42 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that execute if they can successfully trick a user into performing an action such as clicking on a link. Exploitation requires the targeted site to have a publicly accessible page containing an [mla_gallery] shortcode configured with a pagination output mode and an mla_link_href template that reflects a {+request:...+} token, along with enough attachments to trigger pagination.

CVE-2026-104727.description: The Sequential Order Numbers for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via 'condition' Post Meta Array Keys in all versions up to, and including, 3.6.5 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page.

CVE-2026-107627.description: The Greenshift – animation and page builder blocks plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 13.2.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires an administrator to have published a page containing a Text Animated block with Content set to Blocks, a Latest Comments block with excerpts enabled nested inside it, and at least one Animated Texts value configured — conditions that cause the gs-textanimate script to be enqueued and process the comment excerpts.

CVE-2026-107629.description: The Greenshift – animation and page builder blocks plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 13.2.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires the affected post page to include an Advanced HTML Element block with Split Text animation enabled wrapping a Latest Comments block that displays comment excerpts, as this configuration causes splittext.js to be enqueued and to process the comment content container.

CVE-2026-107743.description: The Mapster WP Maps plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting in versions up to, and including, 2.0.5. This is due to the /wp-json/mapster-wp-maps/save-mapmaker REST route being registered with a permission_callback that unconditionally returns true (no capability check, no nonce), together with the mapster_write_config_to_acf() helper only sanitizing string config values with sanitize_text_field() — which strips HTML tags but leaves quote characters intact — and the mapster_wp_map shortcode renderer in mapster_wordpress_maps_shortcode_display() concatenating the stored loading_background_color value into a single-quoted inline style attribute without esc_attr(). This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page.

CVE-2026-109215.description: The LiteSpeed Cache plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'bbp_reply_content' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 7.9.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires that an administrator has enabled Viewport Images (VPI) and configured a VPI filename that matches an image the attacker can embed in user-generated content — such as a bbPress topic where Subscriber-level Participants are permitted to post replies containing raw img tags.

CVE-2026-110707.description: The RSS Aggregator by Feedzy – Feed to Post, Autoblogging, News & YouTube Video Feeds Aggregator plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'media:group/media:description (XML element in the imported feed)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 5.2.12 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires an administrator to configure a Feed-to-Post import pointing at an attacker-controlled feed URL and trigger the import via the Run Now action or setup wizard, which is the plugin's standard configuration flow.

CVE-2026-111318.description: The HT Mega Addons for Elementor – Elementor Widgets & Template Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via the 'href attribute of <a> inside .htmega-tab-nav' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.2.7 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful exploitation requires a co-installed plugin such as wpDiscuz with its rich editor enabled whose markup allowlist permits span[class] and a[href] storage, an HT Mega Tabs widget present on the same page as the comment section, and a victim user click on the injected anchor link.

CVE-2026-111417.description: A broken access control vulnerability exists in the Foxit official website’s HTML-to-PDF conversion service due to the use of a shared token for submitted conversion documents. This may allow unauthorized users to access documents submitted by other users.

CVE-2026-111418.description: A server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability exists in the Foxit official website’s HTML-to-PDF conversion service. Support for ZIP-formatted input can bypass restrictions on requests to internal IP addresses, potentially allowing discovery of internal network resources.

CVE-2026-111419.description: A sensitive information exposure vulnerability exists on the Foxit official website because JavaScript code contains third-party authorization information. This may allow unauthorized parties to obtain or misuse the exposed credentials.

CVE-2026-116763.description: The LiteSpeed Cache plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 7.9.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This vulnerability is only exploitable when the HTML Minify option (O_OPTM_HTML_MIN) is enabled and a companion plugin renders stored comment content into a raw-text context such as a JSON-LD script block on the same page.

CVE-2026-117611.description: Improper certificate validation in Checkmk <2.5.0p18, <2.4.0p39, <2.3.0p52 and 2.2.0 (EOL): the Certificate Authority stores bundled with "certifi" and "webpki-roots" include a root CA that trusts eMudhra (emSign) intermediate certificates whose private keys are public.

CVE-2026-118192.description: The JoomSport – for Sports: Team & League, Football, Hockey & more plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to generic SQL Injection via the 'team_id' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 5.7.11 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database. The vulnerable code path is reached when the season has no associated joomsport_tournament term, which is the default state for newly created seasons.

CVE-2026-88941.description: Kaspersky has fixed a vulnerability in the Network Agent for Windows module of Kaspersky Security Center. The vulnerability could potentially cause the Network Agent module of Kaspersky Security Center to malfunction. There are no evidence of the vulnerability exploitation in-the-wild.

CVE-2026-91152.description: The Everest Forms – Contact Form, Payment Form, Quiz, Survey & Custom Form Builder with AI plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Reflected Cross-Site Scripting via the 'evf_toast_type' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.6.2 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. Exploitation requires the sibling evf_toast parameter to decode successfully via atob(), but this is a trivially attacker-controlled prerequisite.

CVE-2026-91153.description: The Everest Forms – Contact Form, Payment Form, Quiz, Survey & Custom Form Builder with AI plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Sensitive Information Exposure in all versions up to, and including, 3.6.2 via the process. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to extract arbitrary WordPress post meta values — including license keys, API tokens, SMTP credentials, and Stripe or AWS secrets stored on any post type — via form submission notification emails or stored entries. The submission nonce is publicly rendered in every embedded form and can additionally be minted anonymously via the nopriv everest_forms_get_form_update_nonce action, meaning no account or prior authentication of any kind is required to complete the exploit.

Leading to potentially trusting unexpected peer certificates. This can be worked around by setting the SSL_CERT_FILE environment variable for the application to /dev/null. This issue does not affect the Win32 SChannel TLS implementation. This issue affects Apache Qpid Proton C: through 0.40.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 0.41.1, which fixes the issue.

CVE-2026-105042.description: A message body that is deeply nested and decoded by pn_message_body() could overflow the stack and cause a crash. This issue affects Apache Qpid Proton C: through 0.40.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 0.41.1, which fixes the issue.

However there will be no user name set so the effects depend on how the application deals with this condition - which otherwise means that authentication has not completed yet. CVE-2026-115599.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in ThimPress LearnPress learnpress allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects LearnPress: from n/a through 4.4.11.

CVE-2026-115611.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in PluginUs.Net TableOn posts-table-filterable allows Reflected XSS.This issue affects TableOn: from n/a through 1.0.7.

CVE-2026-115963.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in VideoWhisper.com Broadcast Live Video videowhisper-live-streaming-integration allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Broadcast Live Video: from n/a through 7.3.9.

CVE-2026-115964.description: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability in StylemixThemes Motors motors-car-dealership-classified-listings allows Blind SQL Injection.This issue affects Motors: from n/a through 1.4.126.

CVE-2026-115965.description: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability in BuddyPress BuddyPress buddypress allows Blind SQL Injection.This issue affects BuddyPress: from n/a through 14.5.2.

CVE-2026-115967.description: Weak Authentication vulnerability in Hamid Alinia Login with phone number login-with-phone-number allows Authentication Abuse.This issue affects Login with phone number: from n/a through 1.8.78.

CVE-2026-116409.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in WP Swings Upsell Order Bump Offer for WooCommerce upsell-order-bump-offer-for-woocommerce allows Reflected XSS.This issue affects Upsell Order Bump Offer for WooCommerce: from n/a through 3.1.6.

CVE-2026-118984.description: OmniRoute 3.8.0 before 3.8.52 contains an unverified password change vulnerability that allows holders of manage- or admin-scoped API keys or oma_ access tokens to change the management password without the current password. Attackers can send POST requests to /api/settings/require-login to lock out the operator, take over dashboard login, or disable the login requirement entirely.

CVE-2026-118989.description: WebToffee Product Import Export for WooCommerce 2.5.1 before 2.6.8 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in download_remote_file that allows shop_manager users to reach internal services via redirects. Attackers can submit a .csv URL that returns an HTTP 302 redirect to an internal address, causing the server to fetch internal responses and return them as import data.

CVE-2026-33923.description: A signature verification vulnerability was discovered in the update installation functionality due to inconsistent validation of the update bundle contents. An attacker with administrative privileges can remotely supply a crafted update bundle that passes signature verification but runs an unsigned script when the bundle is installed. The script runs with root privileges, allowing the attacker to read or modify sensitive data, change the appliance configuration, or shut down the appliance.

CVE-2026-33924.description: Two OS command injection vulnerabilities were discovered in the update installation functionality due to insufficient validation of the update bundle contents. An attacker with administrative privileges can remotely supply a crafted update bundle that, when installed, causes arbitrary commands to be executed with root privileges, allowing the attacker to read or modify sensitive data, change the appliance configuration, or shut down the appliance.

CVE-2026-71569.description: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in Apache Camel A2A component. This issue affects Apache Camel: from 4.21.0 before 4.22.2. WebhookUrlValidator classified a push notification webhook host in two places that did not agree. A host written as an IP literal was matched against a list of string prefixes that named the IPv6 unique local range fc00::/7, while a host reached through a name was resolved and the resulting address classified with the InetAddress predicates isLoopbackAddress, isAnyLocalAddress, isLinkLocalAddress and isSiteLocalAddress. Those predicates do not cover the same ground as the prefix list: isSiteLocalAddress reports the deprecated fec0::/10 block and not the fc00::/7 unique local addresses that replaced it, and the JDK carries no predicate for them at all. The same address was therefore accepted or rejected depending on how it was written, and a webhook URL whose host name resolved into fc00::/7 passed a guard that refused the identical address given as a literal. PushNotificationDispatcher then sent the push notification to that address, together with any Authorization header carried in the same configuration, whose scheme and credentials the registering caller supplies. The webhook URL arrives as TaskPushNotificationConfig.url from the caller registering the push notification, so it is attacker-controlled, and allowLocalWebhookUrls is false by default, which is the configuration in which the guard is expected to hold. The response is not relayed back to the caller who registered the configuration, so what the gap yields is a blind outbound HTTPS request from the Camel process to an internal address the guard was written to refuse; reaching a service that way additionally requires that the name resolve into fc00::/7 in the target environment, that an HTTPS service be listening on that address, and that the TLS handshake succeed for the name being requested, which is why the severity is assessed medium. The same string pre-check was also wrong in the other direction: it matched the raw host string without first establishing that the host was an IP literal, so any name merely beginning with fc or fd, such as fcm.googleapis.com, was refused outright. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 4.23.0, which fixes the issue. If users are on the 4.22.x releases stream, then they are suggested to upgrade to 4.22.2. The 4.21.x release line reached end of life before this issue was resolved and will not receive a fix, so deployments on it must move to a supported release. Both the literal and the resolved path now classify the address from its raw bytes with one shared classifier, which recognises fc00::/7 and the shared address space 100.64.0.0/10, as well as IPv4-compatible, NAT64 (64:ff9b::/96) and 6to4 (2002::/16) addresses whose embedded IPv4 address is not globally routable. For deployments that cannot upgrade immediately, place authentication in front of the A2A push notification configuration path so that the webhook URL does not arrive from an untrusted caller, and deny egress from the Camel process to fc00::/7 at the network level; where the deployment has no need of IPv6, starting the JVM with -Djava.net.preferIPv4Stack=true removes the address class the gap turns on. Note that allowLocalWebhookUrls=false is already the default and does not by itself close the gap.

CVE-2026-103665.description: The installer for Yamaha LAN Monitor for Windows provided by Yamaha Corporation may insecurely load Dynamic Link Libraries (DLLs). When the installer is launched in a directory containing a specially crafted DLL file, the malicious DLL may be loaded, resulting in arbitrary code execution with administrative privileges.

CVE-2026-109216.description: The Meta Box – A Framework for Dynamic Websites plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'profile_background[<attacker-chosen key>]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 5.15.2 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitability depends on a consuming plugin or theme built on Meta Box that exposes the background field to lower-privileged users and renders stored values via the rwmb_the_value()/format_single_value() pattern; the effective minimum privilege is whatever role that consumer permits, demonstrated at Subscriber level.

CVE-2026-109822.description: Yamaha wireless LAN router NWR100 provided by Yamaha Corporation contains an issue with insecure storage of sensitive information. Configuration files generated by the CONFIG file export function may be read by an unauthenticated attacker.

CVE-2026-110184.description: The Newsmatic theme for WordPress is vulnerable to blind SQL Injection via the 'slug' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.5.0 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database.

CVE-2026-115821.description: The NewsmanApp plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'billing_first_name, billing_last_name' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.7.29 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This vulnerability is only exploitable when the Newsman Remarketing feature is enabled and a non-empty Remarketing ID is configured in the plugin settings.

CVE-2026-119025.description: open 7.2.0 before 11.0.0 contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows attackers to execute PowerShell code by supplying crafted URLs on Windows and WSL. Attackers can embed $(...) subexpressions in URLs, such as OAuth authorization_endpoint values from malicious MCP servers, which execute when index.js passes them unescaped to powershell -EncodedCommand.

CVE-2026-119027.description: oapi-codegen 2.5.0 before 2.8.1 contains a code injection vulnerability that allows attackers to inject Go code by supplying a crafted servers[].x-go-name value emitted unescaped by the server-urls template. Attackers who control an OpenAPI document can define an injected func init() that executes when the victim builds and imports the generated package.

CVE-2026-119028.description: oapi-codegen 2.0.0 before 2.8.1 contains a code injection vulnerability that allows attackers to inject Go code by supplying non-literal enum entries in integer, number, or boolean schemas. Attackers controlling an OpenAPI document can craft an enum entry that closes the const block in constants.tmpl and injects a func init(), executing code when the generated package is built and imported.

CVE-2026-97854.description: Yamaha wireless LAN router NWR100 provided by Yamaha Corporation contains an OS command injection vulnerability. Arbitrary OS commands may be executed by sending a specially crafted request to the affected product.

CVE-2026-97860.description: YMS-VPN8 and YMS-VPN8-CP provided by Yamaha Corporation register Windows services with unquoted file paths. A user who has write permissions on the system drive may be able to execute arbitrary code with SYSTEM privileges.

CVE-2026-113688.description: Server-side request forgery in the SmartIT URL-based attachment feature of BMC IT Service Management Suite versions 25.3.01, 25.4.01, and 26.1.01 allows authenticated users to make server-side requests to internal services and observe response information.

CVE-2026-49142.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an authenticated SQL injection vulnerability in the Syndromic Surveillance module that allows users with Clinician-level privileges to read and modify arbitrary database contents by submitting crafted values in the form_icd_codes[] POST parameter to the syndromicsurveillance/index endpoint. Attackers can inject an unquoted numeric IN() clause and UNION DISTINCT SELECT statement using hex-encoded literals to abuse MySQL extractvalue() for error-based exfiltration of bcrypt password hashes and execute stacked queries that reset passwords, resulting in full administrative account takeover.

CVE-2026-52709.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in bPlugins Video Gallery Block video-gallery-block allows Stored XSS.This issue affects Video Gallery Block: from n/a through 1.6.0.

CVE-2026-56056.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Mamunur Rashid The Post Grid the-post-grid allows Stored XSS.This issue affects The Post Grid: from n/a through 7.9.7.

CVE-2026-93006.description: A flaw was found in dnsmasq. The TFTP server can serve the wrong file contents because a recently used transfer cache is not invalidated when a transfer finishes. An attacker on the local network who can request a TFTP file may cause a later client to receive previously cached data instead of the requested file. In PXE network-boot environments this can substitute attacker-chosen boot content for a victim machine.

CVE-2026-93007.description: A flaw was found in dnsmasq. The TCP DNS service uses a small fixed pool of child processes and does not set a receive timeout on client connections. A remote attacker can open idle TCP connections to port 53 and occupy the entire pool, preventing new TCP DNS connections and DNSSEC validation that requires TCP fallback. UDP DNS resolution continues, and occupied slots are released after a fixed lifetime.

CVE-2026-93008.description: A flaw was found in dnsmasq. When following a CNAME in a DNS response, the resolver can cache records for the CNAME target without checking that those records belong to the responding server's authorized zone. In split-DNS deployments that send some domains to a specific upstream, an attacker who controls that upstream can inject cache entries for unrelated names. Later clients may then receive attacker-chosen addresses for those names.

CVE-2026-93011.description: A flaw was found in dnsmasq. After a reduction of internal domain-name buffer sizes, the DNSSEC validator can write a few bytes past a name buffer when converting names to and from DNS wire format. An attacker who can cause the server to validate a crafted DNSSEC response may overwrite a small amount of adjacent heap metadata. DNSSEC support is not compiled in by default and must also be enabled at runtime.

CVE-2019-25781.description: Python-Markdown 3.0 through 3.11.2 contains an algorithmic complexity vulnerability in inline link parsing that allows remote attackers to exhaust CPU through unmatched brackets. Attackers can submit short Markdown containing repeated [ or ![ characters, forcing LinkInlineProcessor.getText() and getLink() into quadratic scans that keep workers busy for minutes.

CVE-2026-113691.description: Stored cross-site scripting in the SmartIT knowledge-article feature of BMC IT Service Management Suite versions 25.3.01, 25.4.01, and 26.1.01 allows authenticated users to execute stored scripts in other users' browsers.

CVE-2026-113692.description: Path traversal in the SmartIT file-management feature of BMC IT Service Management Suite versions 25.3.01, 25.4.01, and 26.1.01 allows authenticated administrators to read files outside the intended directory.

CVE-2026-113693.description: Exposure of sensitive information in the SmartIT system-account settings of BMC IT Service Management Suite versions 25.3.01, 25.4.01, and 26.1.01 allows authenticated users to retrieve a system username and encrypted password value.

CVE-2026-113694.description: Improper authorization in the SmartIT user attachment feature of BMC IT Service Management Suite versions 25.3.01, 25.4.01, and 26.1.01 allows authenticated users to access or modify attachment resources belonging to other users.

CVE-2026-113695.description: Reflected cross-site scripting in the SmartIT inline-image attachment feature of BMC IT Service Management Suite versions 25.3.01, 25.4.01, and 26.1.01 allows authenticated users to inject script content into HTML responses viewed by another user.

CVE-2026-113696.description: Improper authorization in the SmartIT change approval feature of BMC IT Service Management Suite versions 25.3.01, 25.4.01, and 26.1.01 allows authenticated users to make unauthorized changes to approval state and bypass intended approval restrictions.

CVE-2026-116402.description: Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS) vulnerability in Brainstorm Force SureForms sureforms allows Code Injection.This issue affects SureForms: from n/a through 2.12.9.

CVE-2026-118425.description: A flaw was found in the secure-redirect-uris-enforcer client policy of Keycloak, an identity and access management solution. The issue occurs when the policy is configured to allow loopback addresses, as Keycloak resolves hostnames via DNS during validation. An attacker can bypass domain allowlist restrictions by using a hostname that resolves to a loopback address, potentially allowing the registration of unauthorized redirect URIs.

CVE-2026-119048.description: JeeSite 5.11.0 through 5.19.1 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in the AI CMS chat module that allows authenticated users to access other users' conversations due to missing and reversed ownership checks. Attackers who know or derive a victim's conversation id can call /a/cms/chat/message, /a/cms/chat/delete, or /a/cms/chat/completions to read, delete, or append to the victim's AI chat transcripts.

CVE-2026-119049.description: FreeMail before 5.3.2 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to claim another user's existing mailbox via the POST /api/create endpoint. Attackers who know a victim's address can become co-owners through assignMailboxToUser to read messages and verification codes, set forwarding, and delete mail.

CVE-2026-119050.description: Agno through 3.1.11 contains an unsafe reflection vulnerability in PandasTools that allows attackers to invoke arbitrary pandas functions by supplying model-controlled function names to getattr(). Attackers can use prompt injection to make the agent call pandas.read_pickle on attacker-controlled paths for code execution, or call other readers to read local files.

CVE-2026-119051.description: flat through 6.0.1 contains an uncontrolled resource allocation vulnerability in unflatten() that allows attackers to create huge sparse arrays via unbounded numeric keys. Attackers can supply flattened keys such as a.4294967294, causing iteration with forEach, spread or JSON.stringify to block the Node.js event loop.

CVE-2026-119052.description: llama.cpp b2877 before b11935 contains an uncaught exception vulnerability in the ggml-rpc server that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to crash the rpc-server by sending oversized message lengths. After the HELLO handshake, attackers can send a command such as SET_TENSOR with a length above std::vector::max_size(), triggering an uncaught std::length_error that aborts the process and denies service to all clients.

CVE-2026-119053.description: lwIP 2.0.0 through 2.2.1 built with the SNMP agent contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in snmp_pbuf_stream_writeto() that bounds copies by pbuf->len instead of remaining bytes. Remote unauthenticated attackers knowing the read community can send fragmented SNMP requests to receive adjacent receive-buffer or pool memory echoed in responses.

CVE-2026-119054.description: Multiple Pages Generator by Themeisle before 4.2.5 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows Contributor-level users to inject script via the [mpg] and [mpg_match] shortcode base-url attribute. Attackers can store entity-encoded payloads that pass kses but are decoded by html_entity_decode() and rendered unescaped through {{mpg_url}}, executing script in administrators' browsers.

CVE-2026-25467.description: Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS) vulnerability in ThemeGrill User Registration user-registration allows Code Injection.This issue affects User Registration: from n/a through 5.3.0.

CVE-2026-54862.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Codection Import and export users and customers import-users-from-csv-with-meta allows Stored XSS.This issue affects Import and export users and customers: from n/a through 2.5.9.

CVE-2026-79589.description: The WIFI4 N300 router (Model: T1 Pro) v1.0.0 by U-speed contains an insecure access control flaw that allows an attacker to gain unauthenticated root shell. The vulnerability is caused by the exposure of the UART debugging interface having a lack of authentication, authorization and access control functionality. Once the interface is soldered and connected to the attacker, they gain root privilege to the system.

CVE-2026-93009.description: A flaw was found in dnsmasq. The DHCPv6 client hostname parser can read one byte past the end of a crafted FQDN option because it checks the next label length before confirming the pointer is still inside the option. An attacker on the local network can trigger this with a single DHCPv6 packet. The extra byte is not returned to the client or logged, and no crash has been demonstrated.

CVE-2026-93010.description: A flaw was found in dnsmasq. When DHCP leasequery is enabled without listing allowed source addresses, the server does not check who sent the query. A host on the local network can request DHCP lease records and learn assigned addresses, MAC addresses, hostnames, and related lease metadata. The feature is off unless an administrator turns it on.

2ba5b2c200ff8636e23a7889.title_ko: Alpine Linux, GitLab 서버의 취약점 공격 시도에 대응해 전체 서버 재구축
2ba5b2c200ff8636e23a7889.summary_ko: Alpine Linux 프로젝트는 자사의 GitLab 서버가 CVE-2026-97229(CVSS 10.0) 취약점을 이용한 공격 시도에 노출됨을 확인하고, 보안을 위해 서버를 완전히 초기화했다. 해당 취약점은 GitLab 자체 업그레이드만으로는 해결되지 않으며, 포함된 Ruby 엔진을 특정 버전 이상으로 업데이트해야 한다. Alpine 측은 데이터 유출 징후는 발견하지 못했으나, 보안 무결성을 위해 비밀키를 교체하고 서버를 재구축했다.

d0794223f786c43c12d5ccce.title_ko: 앤트로픽, 바이오 기업 미스릴 메디신 인수…AI 기반 신약 개발 가속화
d0794223f786c43c12d5ccce.summary_ko: 앤트로픽이 AI 모델 '클로드'를 활용해 희귀 근육질환 치료제를 연구해온 1인 바이오 스타트업 미스릴 메디신을 인수했다. 앤트로픽은 AI를 활용해 연구 과정을 조율하고 전임상 단계까지 빠르게 발전시킨 경험을 바탕으로, 신약 개발 전 과정을 직접 운영하며 2028년 인체 임상시험 진입을 목표로 하고 있다.

853afe71676a56889f14b6a5.title_ko: AI 모델 평가사 AA, 벤치마크 개편…구글 제미나이 4 카본 1위 등극
853afe71676a56889f14b6a5.summary_ko: 아티피셜 애널리시스(AA)가 '인텔리전스 인덱스 v5'를 발표하며 코딩 및 과학 연구 능력을 강화한 새로운 평가 체계를 도입했다. 이번 개편에서 비공개 데이터 비중을 60%로 높여 신뢰도를 높였으며, 구글의 '제미나이 4 카본'이 종합 1위를 차지했다. 오픈AI 모델들도 과학 연구 분야에서 강세를 보이며 상위권에 진입했다.

559645c3cd31103bb68900d1.title_ko: 엔비디아, 40개 언어 지원 음성 인식 모델 '네모트론 3.5 트랜스크라이브' 공개
559645c3cd31103bb68900d1.summary_ko: 엔비디아가 40개 언어와 다국어 번역을 지원하는 오픈웨이트 음성 인식 AI 모델 '네모트론 3.5 트랜스크라이브'를 공개했다. 이 모델은 화자 구분 및 문맥 기반 인식에 강점이 있으며, 허깅페이스에 상업적 활용이 가능한 라이선스로 공개되어 기업들이 자체 음성 AI 시스템을 구축하도록 지원한다.

8470af7ff8d190714948b48c.title_ko: 의료 기기 기업 iRhythm 데이터 유출로 약 820만 명 정보 노출
8470af7ff8d190714948b48c.summary_ko: 심장 모니터링 기기 업체 iRhythm이 2026년 6월 발생한 데이터 유출 사고로 약 818만 명의 개인정보가 유출되었음을 확인했다. 해커들은 환자 이름, 주소, 생년월일, 연락처, 기기 및 보험 정보를 탈취하고 이를 빌미로 금전을 요구했다. 현재 iRhythm은 유출된 정보가 실제 범죄에 악용된 증거는 없다고 밝혔으나, 환자들에게 의료 신원 도용 등에 대한 주의를 당부했다.

8652c530fdf37a9e2eed15d1.title_ko: Cisco SD-WAN 취약점 악용한 KeyDrift 멀웨어 발견
8652c530fdf37a9e2eed15d1.summary_ko: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN 시스템의 치명적인 취약점(CVE-2026-20127)을 악용한 'KeyDrift' 멀웨어가 발견되었다. 해당 멀웨어는 트래픽 암호화 키를 가로채기 위해 설계되었으며, 공격자는 이를 통해 관리자 권한을 획득했다. Cisco는 관련 보안 패치를 배포하고 취약한 버전 사용 중단을 권고하는 한편, 시스템 강화 가이드라인 준수를 당부했다.

구글의 신규 모델 제미나이 4 카본이 소프트웨어 취약점 탐지 및 수정 성능을 대폭 강화함.
AI 조언에 따라 약물 복용량을 조절하던 사용자가 사망하여 오픈AI를 상대로 소송 제기.
앤트로픽이 AI 모델의 유해성을 스스로 감시하는 자기 평가 기술을 클로드 서비스에 도입함.

CVE-2026-111730.description: P-Net before 1.0.3 does not validate the LengthPeerStationName field of a CheckPeers block in get_check_peer(). The received length (up to 255) was used to copy data into the 241-byte peer station name buffer and to place the terminating NUL byte, so a crafted block writes up to 15 bytes past the end of the buffer. This can lead to a crash (denial of service) or potentially arbitrary code execution. Requires establishment of session that needs ADJACENT network access.

CVE-2026-111731.description: P-Net before 1.0.3 enters an infinite loop when handling a read request for the PDPortDataCheck record with subslot 0 (whole module). The loop over the ports never advanced to the next port, so the request never completes and the device stops responding. A remote unauthenticated attacker can use this to cause a denial of service.

CVE-2026-111732.description: P-Net before 1.0.3, when built with PNET_OPTION_AR_VENDOR_BLOCKS enabled, parses a data length from a field of the ARVendorBlock request that is not part of the block definition and uses it as the number of bytes to copy into a fixed-size buffer, without comparing it with the buffer size or the block length. A crafted Connect request causes an out-of-bounds write. This can lead to a crash (denial of service) or potentially arbitrary code execution. This option is disabled by default.

CVE-2026-111733.description: P-Net before 1.0.3 dereferences a NULL AR pointer when handling an implicit read request without a valid target AR UUID for a record index that requires an AR (AR specific indices 0xE000-0xEFFF, and the expected identification data of a slot or subslot). A remote unauthenticated attacker can send such a request to crash the device (denial of service).

CVE-2026-111734.description: P-Net before 1.0.3 does not validate the length of a received Ethernet frame in pf_eth_recv() before reading the EtherType, any VLAN tags and the PROFINET FrameID. The VLAN tag loop had no upper bound, so a truncated frame, or a frame consisting only of VLAN tags, makes the function read past the end of the receive buffer. This can cause a crash (denial of service) or disclose memory content.

CVE-2026-111735.description: P-Net before 1.0.3 contains an integer underflow in pf_cpm_c_data_ind(). When handling a received cyclic data frame while the consumer is in the FRUN or RUN state, the offset of the APDU status was computed as the frame length minus 4 using 16-bit arithmetic, without checking that the frame is long enough. A crafted short frame makes the offset wrap around, so the function reads outside the receive buffer. This can cause a crash (denial of service) or disclose memory content.

CVE-2026-111736.description: P-Net before 1.0.3 dereferences a NULL AR pointer in pf_fspm_cm_read_ind() when handling an implicit read request without a valid target AR UUID for a user specific record index, if the application has registered a read callback. A remote unauthenticated attacker can send such a request to crash the device (denial of service).

CVE-2026-112200.description: P-Net before 1.0.3 does not release the Application Relationship (AR) and the RPC session when an RPC request is rejected because its data representation has incorrect endianness. The session and its AR remain allocated, so repeated requests exhaust the available sessions. Once they are exhausted the device no longer answers new RPC requests, including Connect, until it is restarted. A remote unauthenticated attacker can use this to cause a denial of service.

CVE-2026-112255.description: Initialization of a resource with an insecure default vulnerability in OpenText Advanced Authentication Server allows Excessive Allocation. This issue affects Advanced Authentication Server: from 6.4.0.0 through 6.4.3.x, from 6.5.0.0 through 6.5.0.x, and from 6.6.0.0 through 6.6.1.0. The fix for this is issue is to create a secure configuration. The 6.6.2.0 release has a best practice entry if the configuration is unsecure. A secure configuration is to NOT allow creation/recreation of Unauthenticated Endpoints. If creation/recreation of Unauthenticated Endpoints is required, you should only allow it from trusted networks. To remedy this issue, change your configuration to NOT allow creation/recreation of Unauthenticated Endpoints. If you require Unauthenticated Endpoints, you MUST change your configuration to use a non-empty whitelist to specify the trusted networks. An empty whitelist will allow all networks to create/recreate endpoints.

CVE-2026-112256.description: Acceptance of extraneous untrusted data with trusted data vulnerability in OpenText Advanced Authentication Server allows Accessing Functionality Not Properly Constrained by ACLs. This issue affects Advanced Authentication Server: from 6.4.0.0 through 6.4.3.8, from 6.5.0.0 through 6.5.0.10, and from 6.6.0.0 through 6.6.1.0.

CVE-2026-113576.description: Adobe Digital Editions is affected by an Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal') vulnerability that could result in a Security feature bypass. An attacker could leverage this vulnerability to bypass security measures and gain unauthorized write access. Exploitation of this issue requires user interaction in that a victim must open a malicious file. Scope is changed.

CVE-2026-114148.description: Incorrect default permissions in ASP.NET Core allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

CVE-2026-115793.description: P-Net before 1.0.3 does not release the RPC session allocated for an RPC request that names an unknown interface or object UUID, and does not start a timeout for it. Repeated requests with different activity UUIDs exhaust the available sessions. Once they are exhausted the device no longer answers new RPC requests, including Endpoint Mapper Lookup and Connect, until it is restarted. A remote unauthenticated attacker can use this to cause a denial of service.

CVE-2026-115794.description: P-Net before 1.0.3 passes the application alarm callback a data length derived from the variable part length field of a received RTA alarm frame without checking it against the length of the received frame. A short frame can make the callback receive a length of up to 65507 bytes. An application that copies the reported number of bytes reads past the end of the receive buffer. The attacker must have established an Application Relationship and requires ADJACENT network access. Applications that do not use the alarm data are not affected.

CVE-2026-115795.description: P-Net before 1.0.3 does not check that a complete block header is present in the received data before reading the next block in DCP Set and Identify requests. If the last block ends at the end of the receive buffer, the block length of the following block is read past the end of the buffer. In addition, a DCP Set block with a length smaller than the two-byte block qualifier makes the length underflow, so the block is processed with a length of 65534 bytes. This can cause a crash (denial of service) or disclose a small amount of memory content. Requires ADJACENT network access.
